source.text: וַיְהִ֣י אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן וּלְאַבְשָׁל֧וֹם בֶּן־דָּוִ֛ד אָח֥וֹת יָפָ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֣הּ תָּמָ֑ר וַיֶּאֱהָבֶ֖הָ אַמְנ֥וֹן בֶּן־דָּוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after this, and to Absalom son of David [was] a sister beautiful, and her name [was] Tamar; and loved her Amnon son of David.

en.L: And it happened after this: Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, and her name [was] Tamar, and Amnon the son of David loved her.
en.B: Some time after this, Absalom son of David had a beautiful sister named Tamar, and Amnon son of David fell in love with her.
en.R: Later on, David's son Absalom had a beautiful sister named Tamar. Another of David's sons, Amnon, fell in love with her.

es.L: Y sucedió después de esto: Absalón hijo de David tenía una hermana hermosa, y su nombre [era] Tamar, y Amnón hijo de David la amó.
es.B: Algún tiempo después, Absalón hijo de David tenía una hermana hermosa llamada Tamar, y Amnón hijo de David se enamoró de ella.
es.R: Más adelante, Absalón, el hijo de David, tenía una hermana muy hermosa que se llamaba Tamar. Otro de los hijos de David, Amnón, se enamoró de ella.

fr.L: Et il arriva après cela : Absalom, fils de David, avait une sœur belle, et son nom [était] Tamar ; et Amnon, fils de David, l’aima.
fr.B: Quelque temps après, Absalom, fils de David, avait une sœur très belle nommée Tamar, et Amnon, fils de David, s’éprit d’elle.
fr.R: Plus tard, Absalom, le fils de David, avait une très belle sœur qui s’appelait Tamar. Un autre fils de David, Amnon, est tombé amoureux d’elle.

sw.L: Ikawa baada ya haya, Absalomu mwana wa Daudi alikuwa na dada mzuri, na jina lake [lilikuwa] Tamari, naye Amnoni mwana wa Daudi akampenda.
sw.B: Baada ya muda, Absalomu mwana wa Daudi alikuwa na dada mzuri jina lake Tamari, naye Amnoni mwana wa Daudi akampenda.
sw.R: Baadaye, Absalomu mwana wa Daudi alikuwa na dada mzuri aitwaye Tamari. Mwana mwingine wa Daudi, Amnoni, akampenda sana.

vi.L: Sau việc này, xảy ra như vầy: Áp-sa-lôm con trai Đa-vít có một em gái xinh đẹp, tên [là] Ta-ma, và Am-nôn con trai Đa-vít yêu nàng.
vi.B: Ít lâu sau, Áp-sa-lôm con trai Đa-vít có một em gái xinh đẹp tên là Ta-ma, và Am-nôn, cũng là con trai Đa-vít, đem lòng yêu nàng.
vi.R: Sau đó, Áp-sa-lôm con trai vua Đa-vít có một người em gái rất đẹp tên là Ta-ma. Một người con trai khác của Đa-vít là Am-nôn đem lòng yêu Ta-ma.

ko.L: 그리고 이 일 뒤에 이런 일이 있었다. 다윗의 아들 압살롬에게 아름다운 누이가 있었는데, 그의 이름은 다말이었다. 그리고 다윗의 아들 암논이 그 여자를 사랑했다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 이런 일이 있었다. 다윗의 아들 압살롬에게 다말이라는 아름다운 누이가 있었는데, 다윗의 아들 암논이 다말을 사랑하게 되었다.
ko.R: 얼마 뒤의 일이다. 다윗의 아들 압살롬에게 다말이라는 아름다운 누이가 있었다. 다윗의 또 다른 아들 암논이 다말을 사랑하게 되었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu depois disto: Absalão, filho de Davi, tinha uma irmã bonita, e o nome dela [era] Tamar; e Amnom, filho de Davi, a amava.
pt.B: Algum tempo depois, Absalão, filho de Davi, tinha uma irmã muito bonita chamada Tamar, e Amnom, filho de Davi, se apaixonou por ela.
pt.R: Mais tarde, Absalão, filho de Davi, tinha uma irmã bonita chamada Tamar. Outro filho de Davi, Amnom, se apaixonou por ela.

am.L: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ለዳዊት ልጅ ለአቤሴሎም ትዕማር የምትባል ቆንጆ እኅት ነበረችው፤ የዳዊትም ልጅ አምኖን ወደዳት።
am.B: ከዚህ ጥቂት ጊዜ በኋላ የዳዊት ልጅ አቤሴሎም ትዕማር የምትባል ቆንጆ እኅት ነበረችው፤ የዳዊት ልጅ አምኖንም ወደዳት።
am.R: ከጊዜ በኋላ የዳዊት ልጅ አቤሴሎም ትዕማር የምትባል ቆንጆ እኅት ነበረችው። ከዳዊት ልጆች ሌላው አምኖንም ወደዳት።

hi.L: और इसके बाद ऐसा हुआ: दाऊद के पुत्र अबशालोम की एक सुंदर बहन थी, और उसका नाम तामार [था], और दाऊद का पुत्र अम्नोन उससे प्रेम करने लगा।
hi.B: कुछ समय बाद की बात है कि दाऊद के पुत्र अबशालोम की तामार नाम की एक सुंदर बहन थी, और दाऊद का पुत्र अम्नोन उससे प्रेम करने लगा।
hi.R: बाद में ऐसा हुआ कि दाऊद के पुत्र अबशालोम की तामार नाम की एक सुंदर बहन थी। दाऊद का एक दूसरा पुत्र, अम्नोन, उस पर मोहित हो गया।

ru.L: И было после этого: у Авессалома, сына Давида, [была] красивая сестра, и имя её — Фамарь; и полюбил её Амнон, сын Давида.
ru.B: Некоторое время спустя случилось вот что. У Авессалома, сына Давида, была красивая сестра по имени Фамарь, и Амнон, сын Давида, влюбился в неё.
ru.R: Позже случилось вот что. У Авессалома, сына Давида, была красивая сестра по имени Фамарь. Другой сын Давида, Амнон, влюбился в неё.

ja.L: この後のこと、ダビデの子アブサロムには美しい妹がいて、その名はタマルといった。そしてダビデの子アムノンは彼女を愛した。
ja.B: その後のことである。ダビデの子アブサロムにはタマルという美しい妹がいた。ダビデの子アムノンは彼女を恋い慕った。
ja.R: その後のことです。ダビデの息子アブサロムには、タマルという美しい妹がいました。ダビデのもう一人の息子アムノンが、タマルを好きになりました。

uk.L: І сталося після цього: в Авесалома, сина Давида, була вродлива сестра, і імʼя її [було] Тамар, і полюбив її Амнон, син Давида.
uk.B: Через деякий час сталося таке. В Авесалома, Давидового сина, була вродлива сестра на імʼя Тамар, і Амнон, Давидів син, закохався в неї.
uk.R: Згодом сталося ось що. У Давидового сина Авесалома була вродлива сестра на імʼя Тамар. Інший Давидів син, Амнон, закохався в неї.

decisions.choice: Absalom and Tamar: full brother and sister; Amnon: their half-brother
decisions.reason: Absalom was David's son by Maacah, daughter of Talmai king of Geshur (3:3), and Tamar was his full sister. Amnon was David's firstborn, the son of Ahinoam (3:2), so he was Tamar's half-brother and the heir to the throne. Calling both young men "son of David" sets them side by side as rivals within one house.

decisions.choice: loved her: desired her
decisions.reason: The verb covers every kind of love and attraction. What follows shows that Amnon's "love" was desire for her, which turns into hatred once he has had his way (verse 15).

decisions.choice: after this: the trouble foretold to David begins
decisions.reason: The phrase loosely links this story to what came before. Nathan had told David that the sword would never leave his house and that trouble would rise against him from within it (12:10-11). Chapters 13-18 tell how that came about through David's own sons.

decisions.choice: Another of David's sons
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that Amnon is a second son of David, not Tamar's full brother; the Hebrew does this by repeating "son of David".

decisions.choice: passé simple for narration at L and B, passé composé at R
decisions.reason: As the French style guide (section 3) and the Samuel terms note set out, for this block of chapters (2 Samuel 13-24): the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative, used at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the passé composé, as French is spoken and read today. Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: "s’éprit d’elle" (B); "est tombé amoureux d’elle" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say Amnon became infatuated, as the English "fell in love"; the meaning decision (m2) shows the "love" was desire, which the story itself makes plain in verse 15. Literal keeps "aimer".

decisions.choice: Absalón, Amnón, Tamar; Jonadab, Simea, Talmai, Amiud, Gesur
decisions.reason: For this block of chapters: the names of David's household take their usual Spanish forms, Absalón, Amnón and Tamar, as the terms note has them; the other names of chapter 13 follow the usual Spanish spelling and stay the same through the book.

decisions.choice: Absalomu, Tamari, Amnoni
decisions.reason: The names of David's children take the Swahili forms of the Samuel terms note, ending in a vowel as Swahili writes them; Tamari is also the form used for Judah's daughter-in-law in the Swahili Genesis and Matthew.

decisions.choice: "em gái" for Tamar, Absalom's sister
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say whether a sister is older or younger; nothing in the Hebrew says, and Absalom treats her as the one he protects (verse 20), so she is "em gái" to him. Amnon, the firstborn, calls her "em" and himself "anh"; Tamar calls him "anh".

decisions.choice: "누이" for Tamar as Absalom's sister; "그 여자" or her name, never "그녀"
decisions.reason: Korean kinship words say whether a sibling is older or younger; Tamar's age against Absalom is not given, so the neutral "누이" is used throughout. Korean narrative avoids "그녀", so Literal says "그 여자" and Balanced and Readable repeat the name.

decisions.choice: Absalão; Tamar; Amnom
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the names take their usual Brazilian forms: "Absalão", with the nasal ending of "Salomão" (5:14); "Tamar", as Genesis 38 and Matthew 1:3 in Portuguese; "Amnom", with the final "-m" Portuguese writes for a nasal ending, as "Hanum" (10:1). The other names of 1 Samuel and 2 Samuel 1-12 stay as they are there (Joabe, Abisai, Zadoque, Abiatar, Mefibosete, Ziba).

decisions.choice: a amava (L); se apaixonou por ela (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "amar", the verb that verse 15 sets against "odiar"; Balanced and Readable say "apaixonou-se", as the English says "fell in love". What kind of love it was (m2) is shown by what follows, so no level says it in advance.

decisions.choice: the chapter is told in plain, sober Amharic, as the Hebrew and the English tell it: no softening and no added colour; "humble" (ʿinnah) is "አዋረደ" at Literal, "በግድ ደፈረ" (violated by force) at Balanced and "አስገድዶ ደፈረ" (raped) at Readable (verses 12, 14, 22, 32)
decisions.reason: The English levels name the act as violation and rape; Amharic does the same in standard words, without the coarse register of everyday speech.

decisions.choice: "अबशालोम", "तामार", "अम्नोन"
decisions.reason: Absalom as the history-books note; Tamar as Matthew 1:3 and Genesis 38:6 in this translation (another woman of the name); Amnon transcribed.

decisions.choice: "प्रेम करने लगा" (Literal, Balanced); "मोहित हो गया" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Loved" here is desire (m2); Literal and Balanced keep the one verb, which comes back in verse 15 against "hated"; Readable says what it was.

decisions.choice: "Фамарь", "Амнон", "Авессалом"
decisions.reason: As Genesis 38 and Matthew 1:3 have Tamar in this translation ("Фамарь"), and as the note for these books gives Absalom; Amnon as in 3:2.

decisions.choice: "полюбил" (Literal); "влюбился" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The love here is desire (meaning m2); Balanced and Readable say "влюбился", as the English "fell in love".

decisions.choice: Absalom "アブサロム", Tamar "タマル", Amnon "アムノン"; 'achot "妹" at every level
decisions.reason: Names as 2SA-3 and MAT 1:3 (タマル); Tamar is Absalom's younger full sister and Amnon's half-sister (m1), so Japanese 妹 and, for Amnon, 兄.

decisions.choice: 'ahav "愛した" (L), "恋い慕った" (B), "好きになりました" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the word is desire (m2).

decisions.choice: "Тамар", "Йонадав, син Шімеї"; later "Баал-Хацор", "Аммігуд", "Текоа", "текоїтянка"
decisions.reason: Transcribed from the Hebrew with т and г for h, as in the Kings draft; "Тамар" is the form Matthew 1:3 uses.

source.text: וַיֵּ֨צֶר לְאַמְנ֜וֹן לְהִתְחַלּ֗וֹת בַּֽעֲבוּר֙ תָּמָ֣ר אֲחֹת֔וֹ כִּ֥י בְתוּלָ֖ה הִ֑יא וַיִּפָּלֵא֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י אַמְנ֔וֹן לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֖הּ מְאֽוּמָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was distress to Amnon to the point of making himself sick because of Tamar his sister, for a virgin [was] she, and it was too difficult in [the] eyes of Amnon to do to her anything.

en.L: And Amnon was so distressed that he made himself sick because of Tamar his sister, for she [was] a virgin, and it was too difficult in the eyes of Amnon to do anything to her.
en.B: Amnon was so tormented over his sister Tamar that he made himself ill. She was a virgin, and it seemed impossible to Amnon to do anything to her.
en.R: Amnon wanted Tamar so badly that he made himself sick over her. She was a virgin, and Amnon thought there was no way he could do anything with her.

es.L: Y Amnón estaba tan angustiado que se enfermó a causa de Tamar su hermana, porque ella [era] virgen, y era demasiado difícil a los ojos de Amnón hacerle algo.
es.B: Amnón estaba tan atormentado por su hermana Tamar que llegó a enfermarse. Ella era virgen, y a Amnón le parecía imposible hacerle nada.
es.R: Amnón deseaba tanto a Tamar que se enfermó por ella. Tamar era virgen, y Amnón pensaba que no había manera de hacer nada con ella.

fr.L: Et Amnon fut tourmenté au point de se rendre malade à cause de Tamar sa sœur, car elle [était] vierge, et il était trop difficile aux yeux d’Amnon de lui faire quoi que ce soit.
fr.B: Amnon était si tourmenté à cause de sa sœur Tamar qu’il en tomba malade. Elle était vierge, et il paraissait impossible à Amnon de rien tenter avec elle.
fr.R: Amnon désirait tellement Tamar qu’il en est tombé malade. Elle était vierge, et Amnon pensait qu’il n’avait aucun moyen d’arriver à ses fins avec elle.

sw.L: Na Amnoni akafadhaika sana hata akaugua kwa sababu ya Tamari dada yake, kwa maana yeye [alikuwa] bikira, na ilikuwa vigumu machoni pa Amnoni kumtendea jambo lolote.
sw.B: Amnoni aliteseka sana kwa ajili ya dada yake Tamari hata akaugua. Tamari alikuwa bikira, na Amnoni aliona haiwezekani kumfanyia lolote.
sw.R: Amnoni alimtamani Tamari kiasi kwamba akaugua kwa ajili yake. Tamari alikuwa bikira, na Amnoni aliona hakuna njia yoyote ya kumfanyia lolote.

vi.L: Am-nôn bị dày vò đến nỗi tự làm mình đau ốm vì Ta-ma em gái mình, vì nàng [là] một trinh nữ, và trong mắt Am-nôn thật quá khó để làm điều gì với nàng.
vi.B: Am-nôn khổ sở vì Ta-ma em gái mình đến nỗi sinh bệnh. Nàng còn là trinh nữ, và Am-nôn thấy không có cách nào làm gì được nàng.
vi.R: Am-nôn muốn có Ta-ma đến nỗi phát bệnh. Nàng vẫn còn là trinh nữ, và Am-nôn nghĩ rằng mình không thể nào làm gì với nàng được.

ko.L: 암논은 그의 누이 다말 때문에 괴로워서 스스로 병이 날 지경이었다. 그 여자는 처녀였으므로, 암논의 눈에는 그 여자에게 무슨 일을 하는 것이 너무 어려워 보였다.
ko.B: 암논은 누이 다말 때문에 몹시 애가 타서 병이 날 정도였다. 다말은 처녀였기 때문에, 암논은 다말에게 어떤 일도 할 수 없을 것만 같았다.
ko.R: 암논은 다말을 너무 갖고 싶어서 병이 날 지경이 되었다. 다말은 처녀였고, 암논은 다말에게 아무 짓도 할 수 없다고 생각했다.

pt.L: E Amnom ficou tão angustiado que adoeceu por causa de Tamar, sua irmã, porque ela [era] virgem, e era difícil demais aos olhos de Amnom fazer qualquer coisa com ela.
pt.B: Amnom ficou tão atormentado por causa da sua irmã Tamar que chegou a adoecer. Ela era virgem, e parecia impossível a Amnom fazer qualquer coisa com ela.
pt.R: Amnom desejava tanto Tamar que ficou doente por causa dela. Ela era virgem, e Amnom achava que não havia jeito de fazer nada com ela.

am.L: አምኖንም ስለ እኅቱ ስለ ትዕማር እስኪታመም ድረስ ተጨነቀ፤ እርሷ ድንግል ነበረችና፤ አንዳች ያደርግባትም ዘንድ በአምኖን ዓይን አስቸጋሪ ነበረ።
am.B: አምኖን ስለ እኅቱ ስለ ትዕማር እጅግ ተጨንቆ ታመመ። እርሷ ድንግል ነበረች፤ አምኖንም አንዳች ሊያደርግባት የማይቻል መሰለው።
am.R: አምኖን ትዕማርን እጅግ ስለ ፈለጋት ታመመ። እርሷ ድንግል ነበረች፤ አምኖንም ሊቀርባት የሚችልበት መንገድ እንደሌለ አሰበ።

hi.L: और अम्नोन इतना व्याकुल हुआ कि अपनी बहन तामार के कारण बीमार पड़ गया, क्योंकि वह कुँवारी [थी], और अम्नोन की दृष्टि में उसके साथ कुछ करना कठिन था।
hi.B: अम्नोन अपनी बहन तामार के लिए इतना तड़पता था कि बीमार पड़ गया। वह कुँवारी थी, और अम्नोन को उसके साथ कुछ भी करना असंभव लगता था।
hi.R: अम्नोन तामार को इतना चाहता था कि उसके कारण बीमार पड़ गया। वह कुँवारी थी, और अम्नोन को लगता था कि वह उसके साथ कुछ नहीं कर सकता।

ru.L: И было тесно Амнону до того, что он заболел из-за Фамари, своей сестры, ведь она [была] девственница, и трудно было в глазах Амнона сделать ей что-нибудь.
ru.B: Амнон так мучился из-за своей сестры Фамари, что довёл себя до болезни. Она была девственницей, и Амнону казалось невозможным что-либо с ней сделать.
ru.R: Амнон так сильно хотел Фамарь, что от этого заболел. Она была девственницей, и Амнон думал, что никак не сможет добраться до неё.

ja.L: アムノンは悩み苦しんで、妹タマルのために病気になるほどであった。彼女は処女であり、アムノンの目には、彼女に何かをすることは難しく思われたからである。
ja.B: アムノンは妹タマルのことで思い悩み、病気になるほどであった。彼女は処女であったので、アムノンには、彼女に手を出すことなどとてもできないように思われた。
ja.R: アムノンはタマルのことばかり思って、病気になるほどでした。タマルはまだ結婚していない娘で、アムノンには、彼女に近づく方法がないように思えました。

uk.L: І так страждав Амнон, що занедужав через Тамар, свою сестру, бо вона [була] дівою, і тяжко було в очах Амнона зробити їй щось.
uk.B: Амнон так мучився через свою сестру Тамар, що аж захворів. Вона була дівою, і Амнонові здавалося неможливим що-небудь їй зробити.
uk.R: Амнон так хотів Тамар, що аж захворів через неї. Вона була дівою, і Амнон думав, що ніяк не зможе нічого з нею зробити.

decisions.choice: made himself sick: he became ill from his obsession
decisions.reason: The verb form can mean to make oneself sick or to pretend to be sick, as it does in verses 5 and 6. Here it describes how Amnon's frustrated desire wore him down until he was ill; verse 4 shows that it could be seen in his face. Some take it to mean he was already acting sick, but the pretending is Jonadab's idea in verse 5.

decisions.choice: she was a virgin: an unmarried daughter of the king, closely guarded
decisions.reason: A king's unmarried daughters lived in their own quarters and wore a robe that marked them out (verse 18). Amnon could not see her alone without arousing suspicion. The words also show what he wanted: not to marry her but to have her.

decisions.choice: too difficult in his eyes: it seemed impossible to him
decisions.reason: The verb is used of what is beyond someone's power (Genesis 18:14; Deuteronomy 30:11). "In his eyes" means in his own judgment.

decisions.choice: tormented (Balanced); wanted Tamar so badly (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says it was "distress" or "tightness" for Amnon. Balanced says "tormented"; Readable says plainly what the distress was about.

decisions.choice: akaugua (fell ill)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew form can mean to make oneself ill or to pretend to be ill; here it is the illness itself (meaning decision m1), so every level says he fell ill. "Akajifanya mgonjwa", pretending, is kept for verses 5 and 6.

decisions.choice: "अपनी बहन तामार"; "कुँवारी"
decisions.reason: The narrator calls her his sister (Tamar is Amnon's half-sister, m1); "कुँवारी" for an unmarried, guarded daughter of the king (m2).

decisions.choice: "было тесно Амнону" (Literal); "так мучился" (Balanced); "так сильно хотел" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of being hemmed in, as 1 Samuel 30:6 does in this translation.

decisions.choice: "трудно было в глазах Амнона" (Literal); "казалось невозможным" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: It seemed impossible to him (meaning m3).

source.text: וּלְאַמְנ֣וֹן רֵ֗עַ וּשְׁמוֹ֙ יֽוֹנָדָ֔ב בֶּן־שִׁמְעָ֖ה אֲחִ֣י דָוִ֑ד וְי֣וֹנָדָ֔ב אִ֥ישׁ חָכָ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And to Amnon [was] a friend, and his name [was] Jonadab son of Shimeah, brother of David; and Jonadab [was] a man shrewd very.

en.L: And Amnon had a friend, and his name [was] Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David's brother. And Jonadab [was] a very shrewd man.
en.B: Now Amnon had a friend named Jonadab son of Shimeah, David's brother. Jonadab was a very shrewd man.
en.R: Amnon had a friend named Jonadab. He was the son of Shimeah, David's brother, so he was Amnon's cousin. Jonadab was a very clever and crafty man.

es.L: Y Amnón tenía un amigo, y su nombre [era] Jonadab hijo de Simea, hermano de David. Y Jonadab [era] un hombre muy astuto.
es.B: Amnón tenía un amigo llamado Jonadab, hijo de Simea, hermano de David. Jonadab era un hombre muy astuto.
es.R: Amnón tenía un amigo llamado Jonadab. Era hijo de Simea, el hermano de David, así que era primo de Amnón. Jonadab era un hombre muy listo y muy taimado.

fr.L: Et Amnon avait un ami, et son nom [était] Jonadab, fils de Shiméa, frère de David ; et Jonadab [était] un homme très habile.
fr.B: Or Amnon avait un ami nommé Jonadab, fils de Shiméa, le frère de David. Jonadab était un homme très rusé.
fr.R: Amnon avait un ami qui s’appelait Jonadab. C’était le fils de Shiméa, le frère de David ; il était donc le cousin d’Amnon. Jonadab était un homme très malin et très rusé.

sw.L: Na Amnoni alikuwa na rafiki, na jina lake [lilikuwa] Yonadabu mwana wa Shimea, ndugu wa Daudi. Na Yonadabu [alikuwa] mtu mwerevu sana.
sw.B: Basi Amnoni alikuwa na rafiki aitwaye Yonadabu mwana wa Shimea, ndugu yake Daudi. Yonadabu alikuwa mtu mwerevu sana.
sw.R: Amnoni alikuwa na rafiki aitwaye Yonadabu. Yeye alikuwa mwana wa Shimea, ndugu wa Daudi, kwa hiyo alikuwa binamu wa Amnoni. Yonadabu alikuwa mtu mjanja na mwenye hila nyingi.

vi.L: Am-nôn có một người bạn, tên [là] Giô-na-đáp con trai Si-mê-a, anh của Đa-vít. Giô-na-đáp [là] một người rất khôn lanh.
vi.B: Am-nôn có một người bạn tên là Giô-na-đáp, con trai Si-mê-a, anh của Đa-vít. Giô-na-đáp là người rất khôn lanh.
vi.R: Am-nôn có một người bạn tên là Giô-na-đáp. Anh ta là con trai Si-mê-a, anh của Đa-vít, nên là anh em họ với Am-nôn. Giô-na-đáp là người rất khôn khéo và mưu mẹo.

ko.L: 그런데 암논에게 친구가 하나 있었는데, 그의 이름은 다윗의 형 시므아의 아들 요나답이었다. 요나답은 매우 꾀가 많은 사람이었다.
ko.B: 암논에게는 요나답이라는 친구가 있었는데, 그는 다윗의 형 시므아의 아들이었다. 요나답은 아주 영악한 사람이었다.
ko.R: 암논에게는 요나답이라는 친구가 있었다. 요나답은 다윗의 형 시므아의 아들이었으니, 암논의 사촌이었다. 요나답은 아주 영리하고 교활한 사람이었다.

pt.L: E Amnom tinha um amigo, e o nome dele [era] Jonadabe, filho de Simeia, irmão de Davi. E Jonadabe [era] um homem muito astuto.
pt.B: Amnom tinha um amigo chamado Jonadabe, filho de Simeia, irmão de Davi. Jonadabe era um homem muito astuto.
pt.R: Amnom tinha um amigo chamado Jonadabe. Ele era filho de Simeia, irmão de Davi, e por isso era primo de Amnom. Jonadabe era um homem muito esperto e cheio de artimanhas.

am.L: ለአምኖንም ወዳጅ ነበረው፤ ስሙም የዳዊት ወንድም የሣምዓ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ [ነበረ]፤ ኢዮናዳብም እጅግ ብልህ ሰው [ነበረ]።
am.B: አምኖን የዳዊት ወንድም የሣምዓ ልጅ ኢዮናዳብ የሚባል ወዳጅ ነበረው። ኢዮናዳብ እጅግ ብልህ ሰው ነበረ።
am.R: አምኖን ኢዮናዳብ የሚባል ወዳጅ ነበረው። እርሱም የዳዊት ወንድም የሣምዓ ልጅ ነበረ፤ ስለዚህ የአምኖን የአጎት ልጅ ነበረ። ኢዮናዳብ እጅግ ብልጥና ተንኮለኛ ሰው ነበረ።

hi.L: और अम्नोन का एक मित्र था, और उसका नाम योनादाब [था], जो दाऊद के भाई शिमा का पुत्र था। और योनादाब बहुत चतुर पुरुष [था]।
hi.B: अम्नोन का योनादाब नाम का एक मित्र था, जो दाऊद के भाई शिमा का पुत्र था। योनादाब बहुत चतुर आदमी था।
hi.R: अम्नोन का योनादाब नाम का एक मित्र था। वह दाऊद के भाई शिमा का पुत्र था, यानी अम्नोन का चचेरा भाई। योनादाब बहुत चालाक और धूर्त आदमी था।

ru.L: А у Амнона [был] друг, и имя его — Ионадав, сын Самая, брата Давида. И Ионадав [был] человек очень хитрый.
ru.B: У Амнона был друг по имени Ионадав, сын Самая, брата Давида. Ионадав был очень хитрым человеком.
ru.R: У Амнона был друг по имени Ионадав. Он был сыном Самая, брата Давида, то есть двоюродным братом Амнона. Ионадав был очень умным и хитрым человеком.

ja.L: アムノンには一人の友がいて、その名はダビデの兄弟シムアの子ヨナダブといった。ヨナダブは非常に賢い男であった。
ja.B: アムノンには、ダビデの兄弟シムアの子で、ヨナダブという友人がいた。ヨナダブは非常に抜け目のない男であった。
ja.R: アムノンには、ヨナダブという友だちがいました。ヨナダブは、ダビデの兄弟シムアの息子で、アムノンのいとこでした。とても頭がよく、ずる賢い男でした。

uk.L: А в Амнона був друг, і імʼя його [було] Йонадав, син Шімеї, Давидового брата. А Йонадав [був] дуже хитрий чоловік.
uk.B: А в Амнона був друг на імʼя Йонадав, син Шімеї, Давидового брата. Йонадав був дуже хитрий чоловік.
uk.R: В Амнона був друг на імʼя Йонадав. Він був сином Шімеї, Давидового брата, тож доводився Амнонові двоюрідним братом. Йонадав був дуже кмітливий і підступний.

decisions.choice: shrewd: clever in practical matters, here in a crafty way
decisions.reason: The word usually translated "wise" covers skill of every kind, good or bad. Jonadab's wisdom is cleverness in getting things done; he uses it to plan a crime. The same word describes the woman Joab sends to trick David (14:2).

decisions.choice: Shimeah, David's brother: Jonadab was Amnon's cousin
decisions.reason: Shimeah is the brother called Shammah and Shimea elsewhere, the third son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:9; 17:13; 1 Chronicles 2:13). His son Jonathan killed a giant at Gath (21:21).

decisions.choice: a friend: a close companion
decisions.reason: The word means a friend or companion. At David's court "the king's friend" was also a title for a trusted adviser (15:37; 16:16), and it may hint that Jonadab was Amnon's confidant at court.

decisions.choice: so he was Amnon's cousin; clever and crafty
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the family tie and uses two words for the one Hebrew word, so that young readers do not take "wise" as praise here.

decisions.choice: Shiméa
decisions.reason: The usual French transcription of the name, with the accent French writes; used for both books.

decisions.choice: muy listo y muy taimado
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, two words for the one Hebrew word (m1), so that the reader does not take 'sabio' as praise: Jonadab's skill is used to plan a crime.

decisions.choice: mwerevu (L, B); mjanja na mwenye hila nyingi (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the ordinary word for "wise", but here it is cleverness put to a crime (meaning decision m1). "Mwenye hekima" would sound like praise in Swahili; "mwerevu" is clever without approval, and Readable makes the craftiness plain.

decisions.choice: "khôn lanh" (L, B); "khôn khéo và mưu mẹo" (R)
decisions.reason: The word usually rendered "wise" here means cleverness used craftily (meaning decision); "khôn ngoan" would praise him, while "khôn lanh" is quick, practical cleverness. Jonadab and Amnon, cousins of about the same age, speak as "anh" and "tôi".

decisions.choice: "다윗의 형 시므아" (Shimeah, David's older brother)
decisions.reason: Korean names a brother as older or younger. Shimeah (Shammah) was Jesse's third son and David the youngest (1 Samuel 16:9-11; 17:13), so he is David's "형".

decisions.choice: Jonadabe; Simeia
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verses 5, 32, 35): "Jonadabe" takes the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, as "Joabe" and "Abinadabe". "Simeia" follows this verse's form of the name (m2), written without an accent under the 1990 spelling, as "Fineias"; it is the brother called "Samá" in 1 Samuel 16:9 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: astuto (L, B); esperto e cheio de artimanhas (R)
decisions.reason: The word usually rendered "sábio" here names cleverness put to a crooked use (m1). "Sábio" would read as praise in Portuguese; "astuto" says skill with a hint of cunning, and Readable uses two plain words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "योनादाब", "शिमा"; shrewd: "चतुर" (Literal, Balanced), "चालाक और धूर्त" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Transcribed names. "चतुर" is clever with an edge, as the Hebrew word is here (m1); Readable says both sides, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ионадав, сын Самая"
decisions.reason: Jonadab keeps the traditional Russian Bible form. His father Shimeah is David's brother (meaning m2), the same man as Shammah of 1 Samuel 16:9, "Самма" in this translation; the Hebrew spells the name differently here, and Russian follows the traditional form of this passage. A reviewer may prefer "Самма" to make the link plain.

decisions.choice: "хитрый" (Literal, Balanced); "умный и хитрый" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is usually "wise", here clever in a crafty way (meaning m1); "хитрый" says both the skill and the craft.

decisions.choice: Jonadab "ヨナダブ", Shimeah "シムア"
decisions.reason: Names for the book; Jonadab is one form in Japanese though the Hebrew spells it two ways (13:5 m3).

decisions.choice: chakham "賢い" (L), "抜け目のない" (B), "頭がよく、ずる賢い" (R)
decisions.reason: Clever in practical matters, here in a crafty way (m1).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ מַדּ֣וּעַ אַ֠תָּה כָּ֣כָה דַּ֤ל בֶּן־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֔קֶר הֲל֖וֹא תַּגִּ֣יד לִ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אַמְנ֔וֹן אֶת־תָּמָ֗ר אֲח֛וֹת אַבְשָׁלֹ֥ם אָחִ֖י אֲנִ֥י אֹהֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to him, why [are] you thus weak, son of the king, in the morning, in the morning? Will you not tell me? And said to him Amnon, Tamar [the] sister of Absalom my brother I [am] loving.

en.L: And he said to him, "Why [are] you so haggard, son of the king, morning after morning? Will you not tell me?" And Amnon said to him, "Tamar, the sister of Absalom my brother, I love."
en.B: He asked him, "Why do you look so worn out, son of the king, morning after morning? Will you not tell me?" Amnon answered him, "I am in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister."
en.R: Jonadab asked him, "You are the king's son! Why do you look so thin and miserable every morning? Tell me what is wrong." Amnon answered, "I am in love with Tamar, the sister of my brother Absalom."

es.L: Y le dijo: «¿Por qué [estás] tan demacrado, hijo del rey, mañana tras mañana? ¿No me lo dirás?». Y Amnón le dijo: «A Tamar, la hermana de Absalón mi hermano, yo amo».
es.B: Jonadab le preguntó: «¿Por qué te ves tan consumido, hijo del rey, mañana tras mañana? ¿No me lo vas a contar?». Amnón le respondió: «Estoy enamorado de Tamar, la hermana de mi hermano Absalón».
es.R: Jonadab le preguntó: «¡Tú eres el hijo del rey! ¿Por qué te ves tan flaco y tan triste cada mañana? Dime qué te pasa». Amnón le contestó: «Estoy enamorado de Tamar, la hermana de mi hermano Absalón».

fr.L: Et il lui dit : « Pourquoi [es]-tu si défait, fils du roi, matin après matin ? Ne me le diras-tu pas ? » Et Amnon lui dit : « Tamar, la sœur d’Absalom mon frère, je l’aime. »
fr.B: Il lui demanda : « Pourquoi as-tu si mauvaise mine, fils du roi, jour après jour ? Ne veux-tu pas me le dire ? » Amnon lui répondit : « Je suis amoureux de Tamar, la sœur de mon frère Absalom. »
fr.R: Jonadab lui a demandé : « Tu es le fils du roi ! Pourquoi as-tu l’air si maigre et si malheureux chaque matin ? Dis-moi ce qui ne va pas. » Amnon a répondu : « Je suis amoureux de Tamar, la sœur de mon frère Absalom. »

sw.L: Akamwambia, "Kwa nini wewe [u] dhaifu hivi, mwana wa mfalme, asubuhi baada ya asubuhi? Je, hutaniambia?" Amnoni akamwambia, "Tamari, dada ya Absalomu ndugu yangu, ninampenda."
sw.B: Akamwuliza, "Mwana wa mfalme, kwa nini unaonekana umedhoofika hivi kila asubuhi? Je, hutaniambia?" Amnoni akamjibu, "Ninampenda Tamari, dada yake ndugu yangu Absalomu."
sw.R: Yonadabu akamwuliza, "Wewe ni mwana wa mfalme! Kwa nini kila asubuhi unaonekana umekonda na mwenye huzuni? Niambie kuna nini." Amnoni akajibu, "Ninampenda Tamari, dada yake ndugu yangu Absalomu."

vi.L: Người nói với chàng: "Sao [anh] tiều tụy thế, hỡi con trai của vua, sáng nào cũng vậy? Anh không nói cho tôi biết sao?" Am-nôn nói với người: "Ta-ma, em gái của Áp-sa-lôm em tôi, tôi yêu nàng."
vi.B: Giô-na-đáp hỏi chàng: "Hoàng tử ơi, sao sáng nào trông anh cũng tiều tụy như vậy? Anh không nói cho tôi biết sao?" Am-nôn đáp: "Tôi yêu Ta-ma, em gái của Áp-sa-lôm em tôi."
vi.R: Giô-na-đáp hỏi: "Anh là con của vua mà! Sao sáng nào trông anh cũng gầy gò, khổ sở như thế? Hãy nói cho tôi biết có chuyện gì." Am-nôn trả lời: "Tôi yêu Ta-ma, em gái của Áp-sa-lôm em tôi."

ko.L: 그가 그에게 말했다. "왕의 아들아, 너는 어찌하여 아침마다 이렇게 수척하냐? 나에게 말해 주지 않겠느냐?" 그러자 암논이 그에게 말했다. "내 동생 압살롬의 누이 다말을 내가 사랑한다."
ko.B: 요나답이 그에게 물었다. "왕자여, 어찌하여 아침마다 그렇게 야위어 가느냐? 나에게 말해 주지 않겠느냐?" 암논이 대답했다. "나는 내 동생 압살롬의 누이 다말을 사랑한다."
ko.R: 요나답이 암논에게 물었다. "너는 왕의 아들이 아니냐! 그런데 왜 아침마다 그렇게 야위고 괴로운 얼굴이냐? 무슨 일인지 말해 보아라." 암논이 대답했다. "나는 내 동생 압살롬의 누이 다말을 사랑하고 있다."

pt.L: E ele lhe disse: "Por que você [está] tão abatido, filho do rei, manhã após manhã? Você não vai me contar?" E Amnom lhe disse: "Tamar, a irmã de Absalão, meu irmão, eu amo."
pt.B: Ele lhe perguntou: "Por que você anda tão abatido, filho do rei, manhã após manhã? Não vai me contar?" Amnom respondeu: "Estou apaixonado por Tamar, a irmã do meu irmão Absalão."
pt.R: Jonadabe perguntou a ele: "Você é o filho do rei! Por que está tão magro e infeliz toda manhã? Conte-me o que está acontecendo." Amnom respondeu: "Estou apaixonado por Tamar, a irmã do meu irmão Absalão."

am.L: እርሱም፦ «የንጉሥ ልጅ ሆይ፣ ጠዋት ጠዋት እንዲህ የምትከሳው ስለ ምንድር ነው? አትነግረኝምን?» አለው። አምኖንም፦ «የወንድሜን የአቤሴሎምን እኅት ትዕማርን እወዳታለሁ» አለው።
am.B: እርሱም፦ «የንጉሥ ልጅ ሆይ፣ ጠዋት ጠዋት እንዲህ የምትጎሳቆለው ለምንድን ነው? አትነግረኝም?» ብሎ ጠየቀው። አምኖንም፦ «የወንድሜን የአቤሴሎምን እኅት ትዕማርን ወድጃታለሁ» ብሎ መለሰለት።
am.R: ኢዮናዳብም፦ «አንተ የንጉሥ ልጅ ነህ! ታዲያ በየጠዋቱ ለምን ከስተህና ተጎሳቁለህ ትታያለህ? ምን እንደ ሆንህ ንገረኝ» ብሎ ጠየቀው። አምኖንም፦ «የወንድሜን የአቤሴሎምን እኅት ትዕማርን ወድጃታለሁ» ብሎ መለሰ።

hi.L: और उसने उससे कहा, "हे राजकुमार, तुम हर भोर ऐसे दुबले क्यों होते जाते हो? क्या तुम मुझे नहीं बताओगे?" और अम्नोन ने उससे कहा, "अपने भाई अबशालोम की बहन तामार से मैं प्रेम करता हूँ।"
hi.B: उसने उससे पूछा, "हे राजकुमार, तुम दिन-ब-दिन इतने थके-हारे क्यों दिखते हो? क्या मुझे नहीं बताओगे?" अम्नोन ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं अपने भाई अबशालोम की बहन तामार से प्रेम करता हूँ।"
hi.R: योनादाब ने उससे पूछा, "तुम तो राजा के पुत्र हो! फिर हर सुबह इतने दुबले और उदास क्यों दिखते हो? मुझे बताओ, क्या बात है।" अम्नोन ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं अपने भाई अबशालोम की बहन तामार से प्रेम करता हूँ।"

ru.L: И сказал он ему: «Почему ты так худеешь, сын царя, утро за утром? Не расскажешь ли мне?» И сказал ему Амнон: «Фамарь, сестру Авессалома, моего брата, я люблю.»
ru.B: Он спросил его: «Почему ты, царский сын, с каждым утром выглядишь всё хуже? Не расскажешь мне?» Амнон ответил ему: «Я влюблён в Фамарь, сестру моего брата Авессалома.»
ru.R: Ионадав спросил его: «Ты ведь царский сын! Почему ты каждое утро такой худой и несчастный? Расскажи мне, что с тобой.» Амнон ответил: «Я влюблён в Фамарь, сестру моего брата Авессалома.»

ja.L: 彼はアムノンに言った。「王の子よ、なぜあなたは朝ごとにこのようにやつれているのか？わたしに話してくれないか？」アムノンは彼に言った。「わたしは、弟アブサロムの妹タマルを愛しているのだ。」
ja.B: ヨナダブは彼に尋ねた。「王子ともあろう者が、なぜ毎朝そんなにやつれているのか？わたしに話してくれないか？」アムノンは答えた。「弟アブサロムの妹タマルを愛してしまったのだ。」
ja.R: ヨナダブは彼に言いました。「あなたは王子だろう！なのに、どうして毎朝そんなにやせて、つらそうな顔をしているのか？わけを話してくれ。」アムノンは答えました。「弟アブサロムの妹タマルを好きになってしまったのだ。」

uk.L: І сказав він йому: «Чому ти такий змарнілий, сину царя, ранок за ранком? Чи не скажеш мені?» І сказав йому Амнон: «Тамар, сестру Авесалома, мого брата, я люблю.»
uk.B: Він спитав його: «Чому ти такий виснажений, царський сину, ранок за ранком? Чи не скажеш мені?» Амнон відповів йому: «Я закохався в Тамар, сестру мого брата Авесалома.»
uk.R: Йонадав спитав його: «Ти ж царський син! Чому ти щоранку такий худий і нещасний? Скажи мені, що з тобою.» Амнон відповів: «Я закохався в Тамар, сестру мого брата Авесалома.»

decisions.choice: haggard: thin and worn down
decisions.reason: The word means poor, thin or weak. It is used of Pharaoh's thin cows (Genesis 41:19). Amnon's longing shows in his body.

decisions.choice: in the morning, in the morning: day after day
decisions.reason: Repeating a word in this way means "every" (Exodus 16:21). Jonadab sees him every morning looking worse.

decisions.choice: Tamar, the sister of Absalom my brother: Amnon names her by Absalom
decisions.reason: Amnon puts Tamar first, and calls her Absalom's sister rather than his own. He keeps her at a distance from himself as he speaks, and Absalom's name already stands in the story as the brother who will act for her.

decisions.choice: I am in love with Tamar
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Tamar's name first, as the Hebrew does. Balanced and Readable use ordinary English order. Readable turns the opening question into an exclamation and the second question into a request.

decisions.choice: "Tamar, la sœur d’Absalom mon frère, je l’aime"
alternatives: "J’aime Tamar, la sœur d’Absalom mon frère"
decisions.reason: French can front the object and take it up with a pronoun, as the Hebrew puts Tamar first (m3); Balanced and Readable use the ordinary order.

decisions.choice: A Tamar, la hermana de Absalón mi hermano, yo amo
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Tamar's name first, as the Hebrew and the English Literal do; Spanish marks her as the object with 'a'. Balanced and Readable use the ordinary order 'Estoy enamorado de Tamar'.

decisions.choice: "Áp-sa-lôm em tôi" for "Absalom my brother"
decisions.reason: Amnon was David's firstborn (3:2), Absalom the third son (3:3), so Amnon calls him "em".

decisions.choice: Jonadab and Amnon, cousins and friends, speak to each other in the plain style (해라체); Jonadab calls him "왕의 아들아" (L), "왕자여" (B)
decisions.reason: They are of one generation and close companions; the plain style shows the familiarity that lets Jonadab plan with him. Jonadab is respectful of David and Amnon's rank only through the title.

decisions.choice: "내 동생 압살롬" (my younger brother); Absalom says "제 형 암논" (verse 26)
decisions.reason: Amnon was David's firstborn (3:2) and Absalom his third son (3:3), so Korean makes Absalom the younger brother; Tamar calls Amnon "오라버니".

decisions.choice: você (Jonadab and Amnon)
decisions.reason: Jonadab is Amnon's cousin and friend (m2 of verse 3), so they speak to each other with "você", the book-wide address between equals and within the family (1 Samuel 19:2); "filho do rei" names Amnon's rank without making the address formal. Amnon and Tamar also say "você" to each other, and Tamar calls him "meu irmão" (verse 12).

decisions.choice: "तुम" between Jonadab and Amnon
decisions.reason: Cousins and friends say "तुम" to each other. "Son of the king" is kept as a title, "हे राजकुमार" (Literal, Balanced).

decisions.choice: "अपने भाई अबशालोम की बहन तामार से मैं प्रेम करता हूँ" (Literal)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts Tamar first and names her by Absalom (m3); Literal keeps that order.

decisions.choice: "Фамарь, сестру Авессалома, моего брата, я люблю" (Literal)
decisions.reason: Amnon names her first, and by Absalom (meaning m3); Literal keeps the Hebrew order, which Russian allows.

decisions.choice: "утро за утром" (Literal, Balanced); "каждое утро" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Day after day (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: Jonadab and Amnon speak plainly to each other, as friends and cousins
decisions.reason: Close companions; Jonadab still calls him 王の子 / 王子.

decisions.choice: 'achi (Absalom) "弟" at every level
decisions.reason: Amnon is David's firstborn, so Absalom is his younger brother.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ יְה֣וֹנָדָ֔ב שְׁכַ֥ב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבְךָ֖ וְהִתְחָ֑ל וּבָ֧א אָבִ֣יךָ לִרְאוֹתֶ֗ךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֡יו תָּ֣בֹא נָא֩ תָמָ֨ר אֲחוֹתִ֜י וְתַבְרֵ֣נִי לֶ֗חֶם וְעָשְׂתָ֤ה לְעֵינַי֙ אֶת־הַבִּרְיָ֔ה לְמַ֨עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶרְאֶ֔ה וְאָכַלְתִּ֖י מִיָּדָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to him Jonadab, lie on your bed and make yourself sick, and [when] comes your father to see you, and you will say to him, let come please Tamar my sister and let her give me to eat food, and let her make before my eyes the food, so that I may see, and I will eat from her hand.

en.L: And Jonadab said to him, "Lie down on your bed and pretend to be sick. And when your father comes to see you, say to him, 'Please let Tamar my sister come and give me food to eat, and let her prepare the food in my sight, so that I may see [it] and eat from her hand.'"
en.B: Jonadab said to him, "Lie down on your bed and pretend to be ill. Then, when your father comes to visit you, tell him, 'I beg you, let my sister Tamar come and feed me. Have her prepare the food here in front of me, so that I can watch and then eat it from her hand.'"
en.R: Jonadab told him, "Go to bed and act as if you are sick. Your father will come to see how you are. Ask him, 'Would you let my sister Tamar come and bring me something to eat? I want her to make the food here where I can watch her. Then I will eat it from her hand.'"

es.L: Y Jonadab le dijo: «Acuéstate en tu cama y finge estar enfermo. Y cuando tu padre venga a verte, dile: “Te ruego que venga Tamar mi hermana y me dé de comer, y que prepare la comida ante mis ojos, para que yo [lo] vea y coma de su mano”».
es.B: Jonadab le dijo: «Acuéstate en tu cama y finge que estás enfermo. Luego, cuando tu padre venga a visitarte, dile: “Te suplico que dejes venir a mi hermana Tamar para que me dé de comer. Que prepare la comida aquí delante de mí, para que yo la vea y luego la coma de su mano”».
es.R: Jonadab le aconsejó: «Métete en la cama y haz como si estuvieras enfermo. Tu padre vendrá a ver cómo estás. Pídele: “¿Podrías dejar que mi hermana Tamar venga a traerme algo de comer? Quiero que prepare la comida aquí, donde yo pueda verla. Luego la comeré de su mano”».

fr.L: Et Jonadab lui dit : « Couche-toi sur ton lit et fais le malade. Et quand ton père viendra te voir, tu lui diras : “Que Tamar ma sœur vienne, je te prie, et qu’elle me donne à manger de la nourriture, et qu’elle prépare la nourriture sous mes yeux, afin que je [la] voie et que je mange de sa main.” »
fr.B: Jonadab lui dit : « Mets-toi au lit et fais semblant d’être malade. Quand ton père viendra te rendre visite, dis-lui : “Je t’en prie, permets à ma sœur Tamar de venir me donner à manger. Qu’elle prépare le repas ici, devant moi, pour que je la regarde faire et que je mange ensuite de sa main.” »
fr.R: Jonadab lui a dit : « Va te coucher et fais comme si tu étais malade. Ton père viendra voir comment tu vas. Demande-lui : “Est-ce que ma sœur Tamar pourrait venir m’apporter quelque chose à manger ? Je voudrais qu’elle prépare le repas ici, pour que je la regarde. Ensuite, je mangerai ce qu’elle me donnera de sa main.” »

sw.L: Yonadabu akamwambia, "Lala kitandani mwako ujifanye mgonjwa. Na baba yako atakapokuja kukuona, umwambie, 'Tafadhali, Tamari dada yangu aje anipe chakula nile, na aandae chakula mbele ya macho yangu, ili nione na kula kutoka mkononi mwake.'"
sw.B: Yonadabu akamwambia, "Lala kitandani ujifanye kuwa mgonjwa. Kisha baba yako akija kukutazama, mwambie, 'Nakuomba, mwache dada yangu Tamari aje anilishe. Aandae chakula hapa mbele yangu, ili nipate kumtazama, kisha nile kutoka mkononi mwake.'"
sw.R: Yonadabu akamwambia, "Nenda kitandani ujifanye kuwa mgonjwa. Baba yako atakuja kukuona hali yako. Mwombe hivi: 'Je, utamruhusu dada yangu Tamari aje aniletee kitu cha kula? Nataka aandae chakula hapa ninapoweza kumtazama. Kisha nitakula kutoka mkononi mwake.'"

vi.L: Giô-na-đáp nói với chàng: "Hãy nằm trên giường của anh và giả bệnh. Khi cha anh đến thăm anh, anh hãy nói với người: 'Xin cho Ta-ma em gái con đến, cho con ăn, và để nàng làm món ăn trước mắt con, để con thấy và ăn từ tay nàng.'"
vi.B: Giô-na-đáp bảo chàng: "Anh cứ nằm trên giường và giả vờ đau ốm. Khi cha anh đến thăm, anh hãy thưa với người: 'Xin cha cho Ta-ma em gái con đến đút cho con ăn. Xin cho em ấy làm món ăn ngay trước mặt con, để con nhìn thấy rồi ăn từ tay em ấy.'"
vi.R: Giô-na-đáp bảo: "Anh hãy lên giường nằm và làm như mình đang bệnh. Cha anh sẽ đến thăm anh. Lúc đó anh hãy xin: 'Cha cho Ta-ma em gái con đến mang cho con chút gì ăn được không? Con muốn em ấy nấu ngay ở đây cho con nhìn. Rồi con sẽ ăn từ tay em ấy.'"

ko.L: 요나답이 그에게 말했다. "네 침대에 누워서 병든 척하여라. 네 아버지가 너를 보러 오시면 그분께 이렇게 말하여라. '부디 제 누이 다말을 오게 하셔서 저에게 음식을 먹게 하고, 제 눈앞에서 음식을 만들게 해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 보면서 그 손에서 받아먹겠습니다.'"
ko.B: 요나답이 그에게 말했다. "침대에 누워 아픈 척하여라. 그러다가 네 아버지께서 너를 보러 오시면 이렇게 말씀드려라. '제발 제 누이 다말을 보내 주셔서 저에게 먹을 것을 주게 해 주십시오. 다말이 제 앞에서 음식을 만들게 해 주시면, 제가 그것을 보면서 그 손에서 받아먹겠습니다.'"
ko.R: 요나답이 암논에게 말했다. "침대에 누워서 아픈 척해라. 아버지께서 너를 보러 오실 것이다. 그때 이렇게 부탁드려라. '제 누이 다말을 보내 주셔서 먹을 것을 가져다주게 해 주시겠습니까? 다말이 여기 제가 보는 앞에서 음식을 만들게 해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 그 손에서 받아먹겠습니다.'"

pt.L: E Jonadabe lhe disse: "Deite-se na sua cama e finja estar doente. E, quando o seu pai vier vê-lo, diga a ele: 'Por favor, deixe Tamar, minha irmã, vir e me dar de comer, e que ela prepare a comida diante dos meus olhos, para que eu [a] veja e coma da mão dela.'"
pt.B: Jonadabe lhe disse: "Deite-se na cama e finja que está doente. Quando o seu pai vier visitá-lo, diga a ele: 'Peço ao senhor que deixe minha irmã Tamar vir me dar de comer. Que ela prepare a comida aqui na minha frente, para que eu possa ver e depois comer da mão dela.'"
pt.R: Jonadabe disse a ele: "Vá para a cama e finja que está doente. O seu pai vai vir ver como você está. Peça a ele: 'O senhor deixaria minha irmã Tamar vir me trazer alguma coisa para comer? Quero que ela prepare a comida aqui, onde eu possa vê-la. Depois eu vou comer da mão dela.'"

am.L: ኢዮናዳብም አለው፦ «በአልጋህ ላይ ተኛ፤ ታመምሁ በል፤ አባትህም ሊያይህ በመጣ ጊዜ፦ “እባክህ፣ እኅቴ ትዕማር መጥታ እንጀራ ታብላኝ፤ አይቼ ከእጇ እበላ ዘንድ ምግቡን በዓይኔ ፊት ታዘጋጅ” በለው።»
am.B: ኢዮናዳብም እንዲህ አለው፦ «በአልጋህ ላይ ተኝተህ እንደ ታመምህ ምሰል። አባትህ ሊጠይቅህ በመጣ ጊዜ፦ “እባክህ፣ እኅቴ ትዕማር መጥታ ታብላኝ። እያየሁ ከእጇ እንድበላ ምግቡን እዚሁ በፊቴ ታዘጋጅልኝ” በለው።»
am.R: ኢዮናዳብም እንዲህ አለው፦ «ሂድና አልጋህ ላይ ተኝተህ እንደ ታመምህ አድርገህ ተኛ። አባትህ እንዴት እንደ ሆንህ ሊያይ ይመጣል። ያን ጊዜ፦ “እኅቴ ትዕማር መጥታ የምበላው ነገር እንድታመጣልኝ ትፈቅድልኛለህ? እያየኋት ምግቡን እዚሁ እንድታዘጋጅ እፈልጋለሁ። ከዚያም ከእጇ እበላለሁ” ብለህ ለምነው።»

hi.L: और योनादाब ने उससे कहा, "अपने बिछौने पर लेटकर बीमार होने का बहाना करो, और जब तुम्हारे पिता तुम्हें देखने आएँ, तो उनसे कहना, 'कृपया मेरी बहन तामार को आने दीजिए कि वह मुझे खाने को भोजन दे, और मेरी आँखों के सामने भोजन तैयार करे, कि मैं देखूँ और उसके हाथ से खाऊँ।'"
hi.B: योनादाब ने उससे कहा, "अपने बिछौने पर लेट जाओ और बीमार होने का बहाना करो। फिर जब तुम्हारे पिता तुम्हें देखने आएँ, तो उनसे कहना, 'कृपा करके मेरी बहन तामार को आने दीजिए कि वह मुझे कुछ खिलाए। वह यहीं मेरे सामने भोजन तैयार करे, ताकि मैं उसे देखूँ और फिर उसके हाथ से खाऊँ।'"
hi.R: योनादाब ने उससे कहा, "बिस्तर पर लेट जाओ और ऐसा दिखाओ कि तुम बीमार हो। तुम्हारे पिता तुम्हारा हाल देखने आएँगे। तब उनसे कहना, 'क्या आप मेरी बहन तामार को मेरे लिए कुछ खाने को लाने देंगे? मैं चाहता हूँ कि वह यहीं खाना बनाए, जहाँ मैं उसे देख सकूँ। फिर मैं उसके हाथ से खाऊँगा।'"

ru.L: И сказал ему Ионадав: «Ляг на свою постель и притворись больным. И когда придёт твой отец навестить тебя, скажи ему: “Пусть придёт, прошу, Фамарь, моя сестра, и накормит меня хлебом, и пусть приготовит у меня на глазах еду, чтобы я видел, и я поем из её руки.”»
ru.B: Ионадав сказал ему: «Ляг в постель и притворись больным. А когда твой отец придёт навестить тебя, скажи ему: “Прошу тебя, пусть моя сестра Фамарь придёт и покормит меня. Пусть она приготовит еду здесь, у меня на глазах, чтобы я смотрел, а потом поел из её рук.”»
ru.R: Ионадав сказал ему: «Ляг в постель и притворись, что заболел. Отец придёт посмотреть, как ты. Попроси его: “Позволь моей сестре Фамари прийти и принести мне поесть. Я хочу, чтобы она приготовила еду здесь, где я смогу смотреть на неё. Потом я поем из её рук.”»

ja.L: ヨナダブは彼に言った。「寝床に横になって、病気のふりをしなさい。そして、あなたの父上があなたを見舞いに来たら、こう言いなさい。『どうか、妹のタマルを来させて、わたしに食べ物を食べさせ、わたしの目の前で食べ物を作らせてください。わたしはそれを見て、彼女の手から食べたいのです。』」
ja.B: ヨナダブは言った。「寝床に横になって、病気のふりをするのだ。父上が見舞いに来られたら、こう言うといい。『お願いです。妹タマルをよこして、わたしに食事をさせてください。わたしの目の前で料理をさせ、それを見ながら、妹の手から食べたいのです。』」
ja.R: ヨナダブは言いました。「寝床で寝て、病気のふりをしなさい。お父上が様子を見に来られたら、こう頼むのだ。『妹のタマルを来させて、何か食べる物を持って来させてくださいませんか？わたしの見ている所で料理を作ってほしいのです。そうしたら、妹の手から食べます。』」

uk.L: І сказав йому Йонадав: «Ляж на своє ложе й прикинься хворим. І коли прийде твій батько побачити тебе, скажи йому: “Нехай прийде, прошу, Тамар, моя сестра, і дасть мені поїсти хліба, і нехай приготує їжу на моїх очах, щоб я побачив і їв з її руки.”»
uk.B: Йонадав сказав йому: «Ляж у ліжко й прикинься хворим. А коли твій батько прийде провідати тебе, скажи йому: “Благаю, нехай прийде моя сестра Тамар і нагодує мене. Нехай вона приготує їжу тут, переді мною, щоб я подивився, а потім поїв з її руки.”»
uk.R: Йонадав сказав йому: «Ляж у ліжко й удавай, що ти хворий. Твій батько прийде подивитися, як ти. Попроси його: “Чи не дозволиш ти моїй сестрі Тамар прийти й принести мені щось поїсти? Я хочу, щоб вона приготувала їжу тут, де я можу на неї дивитися. Тоді я поїм з її руки.”»

decisions.choice: make yourself sick: pretend to be ill
decisions.reason: The same verb form as in verse 2, here plainly meaning to act the part of a sick man, as verse 6 confirms.

decisions.choice: give me food to eat; the food: a meal brought to someone sick or grieving
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun come from a root used of food given to the sick or the mourning (3:35; 12:17). A sick man asking for a meal from his sister's hand would not seem strange to the king.

decisions.choice: Jonadab: the Hebrew here spells the name in a longer form
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has Jehonadab, the full form of the name, with the divine name as its first part. It is the same man as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: Jonadab
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the spelling of verse 3, so that readers do not think a second man has come in.

decisions.choice: David's sons speak to him as "cha" and of themselves as "con"
decisions.reason: Amnon speaks to his father in a family matter; the Hebrew here has no "your servant", so the parent-and-child forms of the Genesis note are used. Where a son uses court language ("your servant", "the king"), the court forms are kept.

decisions.choice: o senhor (Amnon to his father, the king)
decisions.reason: A son speaks to his father the king with "o senhor", as children to parents and subjects to the king in 1 Samuel (Genesis 27); Literal and Balanced keep the request in the third-person courtesy of "deixe", which suits "o senhor".

decisions.choice: Amnon speaks to his father the king with "አንተ" and "እባክህ", as family members do in this translation; Jonadab, Absalom and the other sons also keep it within the family
alternatives: "እርስዎ", as courtiers speak to the king
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch's rule is that family members say "አንተ" to one another, with respect carried by words such as "እባክህ" and "አባቴ"; David's sons keep it even when, like Absalom in verse 24, they use the court's "your servant".

decisions.choice: "आप" from Amnon to his father the king ("दीजिए"); honorific "तुम्हारे पिता ... आएँ" in Jonadab's words
decisions.reason: A son speaks to his father, who is also the king, with "आप" in this formal request (Pentateuch note), and Jonadab speaks of the king with the honorific a nephew would use. The narrator keeps plain forms for David, as in 1 Samuel.

decisions.choice: "बीमार होने का बहाना करो" (Literal, Balanced); "ऐसा दिखाओ कि तुम बीमार हो" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Make yourself sick" means pretend (m1).

decisions.choice: "притворись больным"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "make yourself sick", which means pretend (meaning m1), as the English says at every level; in verse 2 it is real illness.

decisions.choice: "Ионадав"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells the name in a longer form here (meaning m3); Russian keeps one form, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Amnon's words to the king, as Jonadab scripts them, in です・ます
decisions.reason: A son asking a favor of his father the king.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אַמְנ֖וֹן וַיִּתְחָ֑ל וַיָּבֹ֨א הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לִרְאֹת֗וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַמְנ֤וֹן אֶל־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ תָּֽבוֹא־נָ֞א תָּמָ֣ר אֲחֹתִ֗י וּתְלַבֵּ֤ב לְעֵינַי֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י לְבִב֔וֹת וְאֶבְרֶ֖ה מִיָּדָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Amnon and made himself sick, and came the king to see him, and said Amnon to the king, let come please Tamar my sister and let her make cakes before my eyes, two cakes, and I will eat from her hand.

en.L: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be sick. And the king came to see him, and Amnon said to the king, "Please let Tamar my sister come and make two cakes in my sight, and I will eat from her hand."
en.B: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to him, "I beg you, let my sister Tamar come here and make a couple of cakes in front of me, so that I can eat from her hand."
en.R: So Amnon went to bed and pretended to be sick. The king came to visit him, and Amnon said, "Please send my sister Tamar to me. Let her make two cakes while I watch. Then I can eat them from her hand."

es.L: Y Amnón se acostó y fingió estar enfermo. Y el rey vino a verlo, y Amnón dijo al rey: «Te ruego que venga Tamar mi hermana y haga dos tortas ante mis ojos, y comeré de su mano».
es.B: Así que Amnón se acostó y fingió estar enfermo. Cuando el rey vino a verlo, Amnón le dijo: «Te suplico que dejes venir a mi hermana Tamar para que haga aquí delante de mí un par de tortas, y yo las coma de su mano».
es.R: Entonces Amnón se metió en la cama y fingió estar enfermo. El rey vino a visitarlo, y Amnón le dijo: «Por favor, envíame a mi hermana Tamar. Que haga dos tortas mientras yo la miro. Así podré comerlas de su mano».

fr.L: Et Amnon se coucha et fit le malade. Et le roi vint le voir, et Amnon dit au roi : « Que Tamar ma sœur vienne, je te prie, et qu’elle fasse sous mes yeux deux gâteaux, et je mangerai de sa main. »
fr.B: Amnon se coucha donc et fit semblant d’être malade. Quand le roi vint le voir, Amnon lui dit : « Je t’en prie, laisse ma sœur Tamar venir ici préparer devant moi quelques gâteaux, pour que je mange de sa main. »
fr.R: Amnon s’est donc mis au lit et a fait semblant d’être malade. Le roi est venu le voir, et Amnon lui a dit : « S’il te plaît, envoie-moi ma sœur Tamar. Qu’elle fasse deux gâteaux pendant que je la regarde. Ensuite, je les mangerai de sa main. »

sw.L: Basi Amnoni akalala akajifanya mgonjwa. Mfalme akaja kumwona, na Amnoni akamwambia mfalme, "Tafadhali, Tamari dada yangu aje anitengenezee mikate miwili mbele ya macho yangu, nami nitakula kutoka mkononi mwake."
sw.B: Basi Amnoni akalala, akajifanya mgonjwa. Mfalme alipokuja kumwona, Amnoni akamwambia, "Nakuomba, mwache dada yangu Tamari aje hapa anitengenezee mikate michache mbele yangu, ili nile kutoka mkononi mwake."
sw.R: Basi Amnoni akaenda kitandani, akajifanya mgonjwa. Mfalme akaja kumtazama, na Amnoni akasema, "Tafadhali mtume dada yangu Tamari kwangu. Atengeneze mikate miwili huku nikimtazama. Kisha nitaila kutoka mkononi mwake."

vi.L: Vậy Am-nôn nằm xuống và giả bệnh. Vua đến thăm chàng, và Am-nôn nói với vua: "Xin cho Ta-ma em gái con đến và làm hai cái bánh trước mắt con, rồi con sẽ ăn từ tay nàng."
vi.B: Vậy Am-nôn nằm xuống giả vờ đau ốm. Khi vua đến thăm, Am-nôn thưa với vua: "Con xin cha cho Ta-ma em gái con đến đây làm vài cái bánh trước mặt con, để con được ăn từ tay em ấy."
vi.R: Vậy Am-nôn lên giường nằm và giả bệnh. Vua đến thăm chàng. Am-nôn thưa: "Xin cha cho Ta-ma em gái con đến với con. Xin cho em ấy làm hai cái bánh trong khi con nhìn. Rồi con sẽ ăn bánh từ tay em ấy."

ko.L: 그래서 암논이 누워서 병든 척하였다. 왕이 그를 보러 오자, 암논이 왕에게 말했다. "부디 제 누이 다말을 오게 하셔서, 제 눈앞에서 빵 두 개를 만들게 해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 그 손에서 받아먹겠습니다."
ko.B: 그래서 암논이 누워 아픈 척했다. 왕이 그를 보러 오자 암논이 왕에게 말했다. "제발 제 누이 다말을 이리로 보내 주셔서, 제 앞에서 빵 몇 개를 만들게 해 주십시오. 그 손에서 받아먹고 싶습니다."
ko.R: 암논은 침대에 누워 아픈 척했다. 왕이 암논을 보러 오자, 암논이 말했다. "제 누이 다말을 저에게 보내 주십시오. 제가 보는 앞에서 빵 두 개를 만들게 해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 그 손에서 받아먹겠습니다."

pt.L: E Amnom se deitou e fingiu estar doente; e o rei veio vê-lo, e Amnom disse ao rei: "Por favor, deixe Tamar, minha irmã, vir e fazer dois bolos diante dos meus olhos, e eu comerei da mão dela."
pt.B: Amnom se deitou e fingiu que estava doente. Quando o rei veio vê-lo, Amnom lhe disse: "Peço ao senhor que deixe minha irmã Tamar vir aqui e fazer uns dois bolos na minha frente, para que eu coma da mão dela."
pt.R: Então Amnom foi para a cama e fingiu que estava doente. O rei foi visitá-lo, e Amnom disse: "Por favor, mande minha irmã Tamar vir aqui. Deixe que ela faça dois bolos enquanto eu olho. Depois eu posso comê-los da mão dela."

am.L: አምኖንም ተኛ፤ ታመምሁም አለ፤ ንጉሡም ሊያየው መጣ፤ አምኖንም ንጉሡን፦ «እባክህ፣ እኅቴ ትዕማር መጥታ በዓይኔ ፊት ሁለት እንጎቻ ትጋግር፤ ከእጇም እበላለሁ» አለው።
am.B: ስለዚህ አምኖን ተኝቶ እንደ ታመመ መሰለ። ንጉሡም ሊጠይቀው በመጣ ጊዜ አምኖን፦ «እባክህ፣ እኅቴ ትዕማር እዚህ መጥታ ከእጇ እንድበላ በፊቴ አንድ ሁለት እንጎቻ ትጋግርልኝ» አለው።
am.R: ስለዚህ አምኖን አልጋው ላይ ተኝቶ እንደ ታመመ አስመሰለ። ንጉሡም ሊጠይቀው መጣ። አምኖንም፦ «እባክህ፣ እኅቴን ትዕማርን ወደ እኔ ላካት። እያየኋት ሁለት እንጎቻ ትጋግር። ከዚያም ከእጇ እበላለሁ» አለው።

hi.L: तो अम्नोन लेटकर बीमार बन गया। और राजा उसे देखने आया, और अम्नोन ने राजा से कहा, "कृपया मेरी बहन तामार को आने दीजिए कि वह मेरी आँखों के सामने दो पूए बनाए, और मैं उसके हाथ से खाऊँ।"
hi.B: इसलिए अम्नोन लेट गया और बीमार होने का बहाना करने लगा। जब राजा उसे देखने आया, तो अम्नोन ने उससे कहा, "कृपा करके मेरी बहन तामार को यहाँ आने दीजिए कि वह मेरे सामने दो-एक पूए बनाए, ताकि मैं उसके हाथ से खाऊँ।"
hi.R: इसलिए अम्नोन बिस्तर पर लेट गया और बीमार होने का नाटक करने लगा। राजा उसे देखने आया, और अम्नोन ने कहा, "कृपया मेरी बहन तामार को मेरे पास भेज दीजिए। वह मेरे देखते-देखते दो पूए बनाए। फिर मैं उसके हाथ से खाऊँगा।"

ru.L: И лёг Амнон, и притворился больным. И пришёл царь навестить его, и сказал Амнон царю: «Пусть придёт, прошу, Фамарь, моя сестра, и испечёт у меня на глазах две лепёшки, и я поем из её руки.»
ru.B: И Амнон лёг и притворился больным. Когда царь пришёл навестить его, Амнон сказал ему: «Прошу тебя, пусть моя сестра Фамарь придёт сюда и испечёт у меня на глазах пару лепёшек, чтобы я поел из её рук.»
ru.R: И Амнон лёг в постель и притворился больным. Царь пришёл навестить его, и Амнон сказал: «Пожалуйста, пришли ко мне мою сестру Фамарь. Пусть она испечёт две лепёшки, а я буду смотреть. Потом я поем их из её рук.»

ja.L: アムノンは横になって病気のふりをした。王が彼を見舞いに来ると、アムノンは王に言った。「どうか妹タマルを来させて、わたしの目の前で菓子を二つ作らせてください。わたしは彼女の手から食べたいのです。」
ja.B: そこでアムノンは横になり、病気のふりをした。王が見舞いに来ると、アムノンは王に言った。「お願いです。妹タマルをここに来させ、わたしの目の前で菓子を二つほど作らせてください。妹の手から食べたいのです。」
ja.R: そこでアムノンは寝床に入って、病気のふりをしました。王が見舞いに来ると、アムノンは言いました。「お願いです。妹のタマルをわたしのところによこしてください。わたしの見ている前で、お菓子を二つ作らせてください。そうしたら、妹の手から食べられます。」

uk.L: І ліг Амнон, і прикинувся хворим. І прийшов цар побачити його, і сказав Амнон цареві: «Нехай прийде, прошу, Тамар, моя сестра, і спече на моїх очах два коржі, і я поїм з її руки.»
uk.B: Тож Амнон ліг і прикинувся хворим. Коли цар прийшов провідати його, Амнон сказав йому: «Благаю, нехай моя сестра Тамар прийде сюди й спече переді мною кілька коржів, щоб я поїв з її руки.»
uk.R: Тож Амнон ліг у ліжко й удав, що хворий. Цар прийшов провідати його, і Амнон сказав: «Прошу, пошли до мене мою сестру Тамар. Нехай вона спече два коржі, поки я дивлюся. Тоді я зможу поїсти їх з її руки.»

decisions.choice: make cakes; cakes: a kind of cake, perhaps heart-shaped
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun are built from the word for "heart", and are found only in this story. They may name heart-shaped cakes, or cakes thought to give strength. Elsewhere the same verb means "you have captured my heart" (Song of Songs 4:9), so the words may also hint at Amnon's desire.

decisions.choice: two cakes: a small amount
decisions.reason: Asking for just two cakes makes the request sound modest and harmless.

decisions.choice: a couple of cakes
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of the small number; Literal and Readable keep "two".

decisions.choice: Amnon says "tu" to the king, his father
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: one person is "tu" at every level, the king included; respect is carried by "je te prie", "mon seigneur le roi" and "ton serviteur". This holds for the whole block.

decisions.choice: tortas
decisions.reason: The Hebrew cakes are a kind found only in this story (m1); 'tortas' is the plain Spanish word for flat cakes of dough, and says no more about their shape than the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: mikate (small cakes of bread)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew cakes are a kind known only from this story (meaning decision m1). "Keki" suggests a modern sweet cake and "maandazi" a particular fried snack; "mikate" is the plain word for baked cakes of dough.

decisions.choice: "빵" for the cakes (*levivot*) and "빵을 만들다" for the verb
decisions.reason: The cakes were shaped from dough and baked or fried (verse 8). "빵" is the plain word for baked dough in this translation; "떡" is rice cake to a Korean reader, and "과자" suggests sweets. The wordplay with "heart" cannot be kept and stays in the meaning note.

decisions.choice: uns dois bolos
decisions.reason: "Uns dois" is the ordinary Portuguese way of making a number sound small and casual, as the English "a couple" does (m2).

decisions.choice: the cakes (levivot) are "እንጎቻ", small baked cakes
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names a particular kind of cake, perhaps heart-shaped; "እንጎቻ" is a small home-baked cake of dough, closer than "ዳቦ" (a loaf) or the borrowed "ኬክ".

decisions.choice: cakes: "पूए"
decisions.reason: A kind of cake, perhaps heart-shaped (m1); Hindi "पूआ" is a small sweet fried or baked cake, the kind of dish made at home for someone.

decisions.choice: "лепёшки"
decisions.reason: A kind of cake, perhaps heart-shaped (meaning m1); "лепёшка" is the plain word for a small baked cake.

decisions.choice: levivot "菓子" (L, B), "お菓子" (R)
decisions.reason: A kind of cake, perhaps heart-shaped (m1, uncertain); Japanese uses the plain word.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶל־תָּמָ֖ר הַבַּ֣יְתָה לֵאמֹ֑ר לְכִ֣י נָ֗א בֵּ֚ית אַמְנ֣וֹן אָחִ֔יךְ וַעֲשִׂי־ל֖וֹ הַבִּרְיָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent David to Tamar to the house, saying, go please [to the] house of Amnon your brother and make for him the food.

en.L: And David sent to Tamar at the house, saying, "Please go to the house of Amnon your brother and prepare the food for him."
en.B: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: "Please go to your brother Amnon's house and prepare some food for him."
en.R: So David sent a message to Tamar at the palace. It said, "Please go to your brother Amnon's house and make some food for him."

es.L: Y David envió a decir a Tamar, a la casa: «Te ruego que vayas a la casa de Amnón tu hermano y le prepares la comida».
es.B: David mandó decir a Tamar en el palacio: «Por favor, ve a casa de tu hermano Amnón y prepárale algo de comer».
es.R: Entonces David le envió un mensaje a Tamar al palacio. Decía: «Por favor, ve a casa de tu hermano Amnón y hazle algo de comer».

fr.L: Et David envoya [dire] à Tamar, à la maison : « Va, je te prie, à la maison d’Amnon ton frère, et prépare-lui la nourriture. »
fr.B: David fit dire à Tamar, au palais : « Va, je te prie, chez ton frère Amnon et prépare-lui quelque chose à manger. »
fr.R: Alors David a envoyé un message à Tamar, au palais : « S’il te plaît, va chez ton frère Amnon et prépare-lui quelque chose à manger. »

sw.L: Daudi akatuma kwa Tamari nyumbani, akisema, "Tafadhali nenda kwenye nyumba ya Amnoni ndugu yako umwandalie chakula."
sw.B: Daudi akatuma ujumbe kwa Tamari ikulu: "Tafadhali nenda nyumbani kwa ndugu yako Amnoni umwandalie chakula."
sw.R: Basi Daudi akapeleka ujumbe kwa Tamari ikulu. Ujumbe ulisema, "Tafadhali nenda nyumbani kwa ndugu yako Amnoni umpikie chakula."

vi.L: Đa-vít sai [người] đến nhà với Ta-ma mà nói: "Xin con hãy đi đến nhà Am-nôn anh con và làm món ăn cho anh ấy."
vi.B: Đa-vít sai người vào cung báo cho Ta-ma: "Con hãy đến nhà Am-nôn anh con và nấu chút gì cho anh ấy ăn."
vi.R: Vậy Đa-vít sai người vào cung nói với Ta-ma: "Con hãy đến nhà Am-nôn anh con và nấu cho anh ấy chút gì để ăn."

ko.L: 다윗이 다말에게 집으로 사람을 보내어 말했다. "부디 네 오라버니 암논의 집으로 가서 그를 위해 음식을 만들어 주어라."
ko.B: 다윗이 궁에 있는 다말에게 사람을 보내어 말했다. "네 오라버니 암논의 집에 가서 그에게 먹을 것을 좀 만들어 주어라."
ko.R: 다윗은 궁에 있는 다말에게 사람을 보내어 전했다. "네 오라버니 암논의 집에 가서 먹을 것을 좀 만들어 주어라."

pt.L: E Davi enviou [recado] a Tamar, na casa, dizendo: "Vá, por favor, à casa de Amnom, seu irmão, e prepare a comida para ele."
pt.B: Davi mandou dizer a Tamar, no palácio: "Por favor, vá à casa do seu irmão Amnom e prepare alguma comida para ele."
pt.R: Então Davi mandou um recado a Tamar no palácio. O recado dizia: "Por favor, vá à casa do seu irmão Amnom e faça alguma comida para ele."

am.L: ዳዊትም ወደ ትዕማር ወደ ቤት፦ «እባክሽ ወደ ወንድምሽ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሂጂ፤ ምግብም አዘጋጅለት» ብሎ ላከ።
am.B: ዳዊትም ወደ ቤተ መንግሥቱ ወደ ትዕማር፦ «እባክሽ ወደ ወንድምሽ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሄደሽ ምግብ አዘጋጅለት» ብሎ ላከባት።
am.R: ስለዚህ ዳዊት በቤተ መንግሥቱ ወዳለችው ወደ ትዕማር መልእክት ላከ። መልእክቱም፦ «እባክሽ ወደ ወንድምሽ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሄደሽ ምግብ አዘጋጅለት» የሚል ነበረ።

hi.L: और दाऊद ने तामार के पास घर में यह कहला भेजा, "कृपया अपने भाई अम्नोन के घर जाओ और उसके लिए भोजन तैयार करो।"
hi.B: दाऊद ने महल में तामार को कहला भेजा, "अपने भाई अम्नोन के घर जाओ और उसके लिए कुछ भोजन तैयार करो।"
hi.R: इसलिए दाऊद ने महल में तामार को संदेश भेजा। उसमें लिखा था, "अपने भाई अम्नोन के घर जाओ और उसके लिए कुछ खाना बनाओ।"

ru.L: И послал Давид к Фамари в дом, говоря: «Пойди, прошу, в дом Амнона, твоего брата, и приготовь ему еду.»
ru.B: Давид послал во дворец сказать Фамари: «Пожалуйста, сходи в дом твоего брата Амнона и приготовь ему поесть.»
ru.R: Тогда Давид отправил Фамари во дворец весть. Там говорилось: «Пожалуйста, сходи в дом твоего брата Амнона и приготовь ему поесть.»

ja.L: ダビデはタマルのいる家に[人を]遣わして言った。「どうか、兄アムノンの家に行って、彼のために食べ物を作ってやりなさい。」
ja.B: ダビデは王宮にいるタマルのもとに使いを送った。「兄アムノンの家に行って、何か食べ物を作ってやっておくれ。」
ja.R: そこでダビデは、王宮にいるタマルに知らせを送りました。「お兄さんのアムノンの家に行って、何か食べ物を作ってあげなさい。」

uk.L: І послав Давид до Тамар у дім, кажучи: «Піди, прошу, до дому Амнона, твого брата, і приготуй йому їжу.»
uk.B: Давид послав сказати Тамар у палаці: «Прошу, піди до дому свого брата Амнона й приготуй йому їсти.»
uk.R: Тож Давид послав звістку Тамар у палац. У ній було сказано: «Прошу, піди до дому свого брата Амнона й приготуй йому щось поїсти.»

decisions.choice: the house: the royal palace
decisions.reason: "The house" here is the king's house, where Tamar lived. The king's grown sons had houses of their own (verse 8; 14:24).

decisions.choice: David sent: the king himself sends her
decisions.reason: The plan works through David's own order. He does not suspect anything, and Tamar goes because her father has told her to.

decisions.choice: the palace
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "palace" for "the house", since it was the king's.

decisions.choice: "오라버니" for Amnon as Tamar's brother
decisions.reason: A sister calls an older brother "오라버니" (or "오빠"); Amnon, the firstborn, was older than Tamar. "오라버니" is the respectful form fitting a king's daughter and keeps a distance that "오빠" lacks.

decisions.choice: "तुम" from David to his daughter
decisions.reason: A father speaks to his daughter with "तुम". "Please" (na) is "कृपया" at Literal; Balanced and Readable leave it in the gentle imperative, as a father would.

decisions.choice: "в дом" (Literal); "во дворец" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The house is the royal palace (meaning m1), as at 7:1.

decisions.choice: David to his daughter plain and gentle (〜やりなさい, B 〜やっておくれ)
decisions.reason: A father's request, softened by the Hebrew na.

source.text: וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֗ר בֵּ֛ית אַמְנ֥וֹן אָחִ֖יהָ וְה֣וּא שֹׁכֵ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֨ח אֶת־הַבָּצֵ֤ק וַתָּ֨לָשׁ֙ וַתְּלַבֵּ֣ב לְעֵינָ֔יו וַתְּבַשֵּׁ֖ל אֶת־הַלְּבִבֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Tamar [to the] house of Amnon her brother, and he [was] lying down; and she took the dough and kneaded and made cakes before his eyes, and baked the cakes.

en.L: And Tamar went to the house of Amnon her brother, and he [was] lying down. And she took the dough and kneaded [it] and made cakes in his sight and baked the cakes.
en.B: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house, where he was lying in bed. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes while he watched, and baked them.
en.R: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house. He was lying in bed. She took some dough and kneaded it. She shaped it into cakes while he watched, and she cooked them.

es.L: Y Tamar fue a la casa de Amnón su hermano, y él [estaba] acostado. Y tomó la masa y [la] amasó, e hizo tortas ante sus ojos, y coció las tortas.
es.B: Tamar fue a casa de su hermano Amnón, que estaba acostado en la cama. Tomó masa, la amasó, hizo las tortas mientras él miraba, y las coció.
es.R: Tamar fue a casa de su hermano Amnón. Él estaba acostado en la cama. Ella tomó un poco de masa y la amasó. Le dio forma de tortas mientras él la miraba, y las coció.

fr.L: Et Tamar alla à la maison d’Amnon son frère, et il [était] couché ; et elle prit la pâte, et la pétrit, et fit des gâteaux sous ses yeux, et fit cuire les gâteaux.
fr.B: Tamar se rendit donc chez son frère Amnon, qui était couché. Elle prit de la pâte, la pétrit, façonna des gâteaux sous ses yeux et les fit cuire.
fr.R: Tamar est donc allée chez son frère Amnon. Il était couché. Elle a pris de la pâte et l’a pétrie. Elle en a fait des gâteaux pendant qu’il la regardait, et elle les a fait cuire.

sw.L: Tamari akaenda kwenye nyumba ya Amnoni ndugu yake, naye [alikuwa] amelala. Akachukua unga, akaukanda, akatengeneza mikate mbele ya macho yake, akaioka mikate hiyo.
sw.B: Basi Tamari akaenda nyumbani kwa ndugu yake Amnoni, ambako alikuwa amelala kitandani. Akachukua unga, akaukanda, akatengeneza mikate huku akimtazama, akaioka.
sw.R: Basi Tamari akaenda nyumbani kwa ndugu yake Amnoni. Amnoni alikuwa amelala kitandani. Tamari akachukua unga akaukanda. Akautengeneza kuwa mikate huku Amnoni akimtazama, kisha akaipika.

vi.L: Ta-ma đi đến nhà Am-nôn anh mình, và chàng đang nằm. Nàng lấy bột, nhồi, làm bánh trước mắt chàng và nướng bánh.
vi.B: Vậy Ta-ma đến nhà Am-nôn anh mình, lúc ấy chàng đang nằm trên giường. Nàng lấy bột nhồi, nặn bánh trước mặt chàng rồi nướng bánh.
vi.R: Vậy Ta-ma đến nhà Am-nôn anh mình. Chàng đang nằm trên giường. Nàng lấy một ít bột và nhồi. Nàng nặn bột thành bánh trong khi chàng nhìn, rồi nướng bánh.

ko.L: 다말이 그의 오라버니 암논의 집으로 갔는데, 그는 누워 있었다. 다말이 반죽을 가져다가 이기고 그의 눈앞에서 빵을 빚어 그 빵을 구웠다.
ko.B: 그래서 다말이 오라버니 암논의 집으로 갔다. 암논은 침대에 누워 있었다. 다말은 반죽을 가져다가 이겨서 암논이 보는 앞에서 빵을 빚고 구웠다.
ko.R: 다말은 오라버니 암논의 집으로 갔다. 암논은 침대에 누워 있었다. 다말은 밀가루 반죽을 가져다가 주물렀다. 그리고 암논이 보는 앞에서 빵 모양을 빚어 구웠다.

pt.L: E Tamar foi à casa de Amnom, seu irmão, e ele [estava] deitado. E ela pegou a massa, e [a] amassou, e fez bolos diante dos olhos dele, e assou os bolos.
pt.B: Tamar foi à casa do seu irmão Amnom, que estava deitado na cama. Ela pegou massa, amassou-a, fez os bolos enquanto ele olhava e os assou.
pt.R: Então Tamar foi à casa do seu irmão Amnom. Ele estava deitado na cama. Ela pegou um pouco de massa e a amassou. Fez os bolos enquanto ele olhava e depois os assou.

am.L: ትዕማርም ወደ ወንድሟ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሄደች፤ እርሱም ተኝቶ ነበረ፤ ሊጡንም ወስዳ አሸች፤ በዓይኑም ፊት እንጎቻ አደረገች፤ እንጎቻውንም ጋገረች።
am.B: ስለዚህ ትዕማር ወደ ወንድሟ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሄደች፤ እርሱም በአልጋው ላይ ተኝቶ ነበረ። እርሷም ሊጥ ወስዳ አሸች፤ እርሱ እያየም እንጎቻ አድርጋ ጋገረች።
am.R: ስለዚህ ትዕማር ወደ ወንድሟ ወደ አምኖን ቤት ሄደች። እርሱ በአልጋው ላይ ተኝቶ ነበረ። እርሷም ሊጥ ወስዳ አሸች። እርሱ እያያት እንጎቻ አድርጋ ጋገረች።

hi.L: और तामार अपने भाई अम्नोन के घर गई, और वह लेटा हुआ [था]। और उसने आटा लेकर गूँधा, और उसकी आँखों के सामने पूए बनाए, और पूए पकाए।
hi.B: तामार अपने भाई अम्नोन के घर गई, जहाँ वह बिछौने पर लेटा था। उसने आटा लिया, गूँधा, उसके देखते पूए बनाए, और उन्हें पकाया।
hi.R: तब तामार अपने भाई अम्नोन के घर गई। वह बिस्तर पर लेटा था। तामार ने थोड़ा आटा लेकर गूँधा। उसने उसके देखते-देखते पूए बनाए, और उन्हें पकाया।

ru.L: И пошла Фамарь в дом Амнона, своего брата, а он лежал. И взяла она тесто, и замесила, и сделала лепёшки у него на глазах, и испекла лепёшки.
ru.B: Фамарь пошла в дом своего брата Амнона, а он лежал в постели. Она взяла тесто, замесила его, сделала у него на глазах лепёшки и испекла их.
ru.R: Фамарь пошла в дом своего брата Амнона. Он лежал в постели. Она взяла тесто и замесила его. Она слепила из него лепёшки, пока он смотрел, и испекла их.

ja.L: タマルは兄アムノンの家に行った。彼は横になっていた。彼女は練り粉を取ってこね、彼の目の前で菓子を作り、その菓子を焼いた。
ja.B: タマルが兄アムノンの家に行くと、彼は横になっていた。彼女は練り粉を取ってこね、彼の見ている前で菓子を作って焼いた。
ja.R: タマルは、兄アムノンの家に行きました。アムノンは寝床に横になっていました。タマルは粉を練って、アムノンが見ている前で、お菓子の形に整えて焼きました。

uk.L: І пішла Тамар до дому Амнона, свого брата, а він лежав. І взяла вона тісто, і замісила, і зробила коржі на його очах, і спекла коржі.
uk.B: Тож Тамар пішла до дому свого брата Амнона, де він лежав у ліжку. Вона взяла тісто, замісила його, на його очах зробила коржі й спекла їх.
uk.R: Тож Тамар пішла до дому свого брата Амнона. Він лежав у ліжку. Вона взяла тісто й замісила його. Вона зліпила з нього коржі, поки він дивився, і спекла їх.

decisions.choice: baked: cooked
decisions.reason: The verb means to cook in general, by boiling or baking. With cakes of dough, baking or frying is meant.

decisions.choice: kneaded: the written and the read forms differ only in spelling
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes this verb one way in its letters and its scribes' notes read it another way. Both forms mean "she kneaded"; nothing in the sense changes.

decisions.choice: she took, kneaded, made, baked: each step told
decisions.reason: The run of short verbs slows the story and shows Tamar doing all that she was asked, in full view of Amnon.

source.text: וַתִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־הַמַּשְׂרֵת֙ וַתִּצֹ֣ק לְפָנָ֔יו וַיְמָאֵ֖ן לֶאֱכ֑וֹל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַמְנ֗וֹן הוֹצִ֤יאוּ כָל־אִישׁ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י וַיֵּצְא֥וּ כָל־אִ֖ישׁ מֵעָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And she took the pan and poured out before him, and he refused to eat; and said Amnon, send out every man from with me; and went out every man from with him.

en.L: And she took the pan and poured [them] out before him, but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, "Send everyone out from me." And everyone went out from him.
en.B: Then she took the pan and set the cakes out before him, but he refused to eat. "Send everyone out of here," Amnon said, and they all left him.
en.R: Then she took the pan and served him the cakes, but he would not eat. Amnon said, "Make everyone leave!" So everyone went out.

es.L: Y tomó la sartén y [las] vació delante de él, pero él se negó a comer. Y Amnón dijo: «{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} salir a todos de mi lado». Y salieron todos de su lado.
es.B: Luego tomó la sartén y le sirvió las tortas delante de él, pero él se negó a comer. «Que salgan todos de aquí», dijo Amnón, y todos lo dejaron.
es.R: Luego tomó la sartén y le sirvió las tortas, pero él no quiso comer. Amnón dijo: «¡Que se vayan todos!». Y todos salieron.

fr.L: Et elle prit la poêle et [les] versa devant lui, mais il refusa de manger. Et Amnon dit : « Faites sortir tout le monde d’auprès de moi. » Et tout le monde sortit d’auprès de lui.
fr.B: Puis elle prit la poêle et disposa les gâteaux devant lui, mais il refusa de manger. « Faites sortir tout le monde d’ici », dit Amnon ; et tous le laissèrent.
fr.R: Ensuite, elle a pris la poêle et lui a servi les gâteaux, mais il n’a pas voulu manger. Amnon a dit : « Faites sortir tout le monde ! » Alors tout le monde est sorti.

sw.L: Akachukua kikaango akaimimina mbele yake, lakini akakataa kula. Amnoni akasema, "Watoeni watu wote kutoka kwangu." Watu wote wakatoka kwake.
sw.B: Kisha akachukua kikaango, akampakulia mikate mbele yake, lakini akakataa kula. Amnoni akasema, "Watoeni watu wote humu," nao wote wakatoka.
sw.R: Kisha akachukua kikaango, akampakulia ile mikate, lakini hakutaka kula. Amnoni akasema, "Kila mtu atoke!" Basi wote wakatoka nje.

vi.L: Nàng lấy chảo và đổ [bánh] ra trước mặt chàng, nhưng chàng không chịu ăn. Am-nôn nói: "Hãy cho mọi người ra khỏi chỗ ta." Mọi người đều ra khỏi chỗ chàng.
vi.B: Rồi nàng lấy chảo, trút bánh ra trước mặt chàng, nhưng chàng không chịu ăn. Am-nôn nói: "Cho mọi người ra khỏi đây." Thế là mọi người đều ra ngoài.
vi.R: Rồi nàng lấy chảo và dọn bánh cho chàng, nhưng chàng không ăn. Am-nôn nói: "Bảo mọi người ra ngoài hết!" Vậy mọi người đều đi ra.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 냄비를 가져다가 그 앞에 쏟아 놓았으나, 그는 먹기를 거절했다. 그리고 암논이 말했다. "모든 사람을 내게서 내보내라." 그러자 모든 사람이 그에게서 나갔다.
ko.B: 다말이 냄비를 들고 빵을 그 앞에 차려 놓았으나, 암논은 먹으려 하지 않았다. 암논이 말했다. "모두 여기서 내보내라." 그러자 모두 그에게서 나갔다.
ko.R: 다말이 냄비를 가져와 빵을 내놓았지만, 암논은 먹지 않았다. 암논이 말했다. "모두 밖으로 나가게 해라!" 그러자 모두 나갔다.

pt.L: E ela pegou a panela e [os] despejou diante dele, mas ele se recusou a comer. E Amnom disse: "Façam sair todos de junto de mim." E todos saíram de junto dele.
pt.B: Então ela pegou a panela e serviu os bolos diante dele, mas ele não quis comer. "Mandem todos sair daqui", disse Amnom, e todos saíram de perto dele.
pt.R: Depois ela pegou a panela e serviu os bolos a ele, mas ele não quis comer. Amnom disse: "Mandem todo mundo embora!" Então todos saíram.

am.L: መጥበሻውንም ወስዳ በፊቱ ገለበጠች፤ እርሱ ግን ሊበላ እንቢ አለ። አምኖንም፦ «ሰውን ሁሉ ከእኔ ዘንድ አስወጡ» አለ። ሰውም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ወጣ።
am.B: ከዚያም መጥበሻውን ወስዳ እንጎቻውን በፊቱ አቀረበች፤ እርሱ ግን ሊበላ እንቢ አለ። አምኖንም፦ «ሁሉንም ከዚህ አስወጡ» አለ፤ ሁሉም ትተውት ወጡ።
am.R: ከዚያም መጥበሻውን ወስዳ እንጎቻውን አቀረበችለት፤ እርሱ ግን አልበላም። አምኖንም፦ «ሁሉም ይውጡ!» አለ። ስለዚህ ሁሉም ወጡ።

hi.L: और उसने कड़ाही लेकर उसके सामने उँडेल दिए, पर उसने खाने से इनकार किया। और अम्नोन ने कहा, "हर एक को मेरे पास से बाहर निकाल दो।" और हर एक उसके पास से बाहर चला गया।
hi.B: फिर उसने कड़ाही लेकर पूए उसके सामने रख दिए, पर उसने खाने से इनकार किया। "सबको यहाँ से बाहर भेज दो," अम्नोन ने कहा, और सब उसके पास से चले गए।
hi.R: फिर उसने कड़ाही लेकर पूए उसे परोसे, पर उसने खाने से मना कर दिया। अम्नोन ने कहा, "सबको यहाँ से बाहर निकालो!" तो सब लोग बाहर चले गए।

ru.L: И взяла она сковороду, и выложила [их] перед ним, но он отказался есть. И сказал Амнон: «Выведите всех от меня.» И вышли все от него.
ru.B: Потом она взяла сковороду и выложила лепёшки перед ним, но он отказался есть. «Пусть все выйдут отсюда», — сказал Амнон, и все ушли от него.
ru.R: Потом она взяла сковороду и подала ему лепёшки, но он не стал есть. Амнон сказал: «Пусть все уйдут!» И все вышли.

ja.L: そして彼女は鍋を取って、彼の前に[菓子を]出したが、彼は食べようとしなかった。アムノンは言った。「皆をわたしのもとから出て行かせよ。」皆は彼のもとから出て行った。
ja.B: それから彼女は鍋を取って、菓子を彼の前に出したが、彼は食べようとしなかった。「皆をここから出て行かせよ」とアムノンが言うと、皆、彼のもとから出て行った。
ja.R: それからタマルは鍋を持って来て、お菓子を出しましたが、アムノンは食べようとしませんでした。アムノンは言いました。「みんな、ここから出て行け！」そこで、みな出て行きました。

uk.L: І взяла вона сковороду, і виклала перед ним, але він відмовився їсти. І сказав Амнон: «Виведіть усіх від мене.» І вийшли всі від нього.
uk.B: Потім вона взяла сковороду й виклала коржі перед ним, але він відмовився їсти. «Виведіть усіх звідси», — сказав Амнон, і всі вийшли від нього.
uk.R: Потім вона взяла сковороду й подала йому коржі, але він не захотів їсти. Амнон сказав: «Нехай усі вийдуть!» Тож усі вийшли.

decisions.choice: the pan; poured out: she tipped the cakes out of the pan
decisions.reason: The word for the pan is found only here, so its exact shape is not known. "Poured out" suggests she turned the cakes out of it in front of him.

decisions.choice: send everyone out from me: the words Joseph used
decisions.reason: Joseph gave the same order before he made himself known to his brothers (Genesis 45:1). There it cleared the room for a family reunion; here it clears the room for a crime against a sister.

decisions.choice: every man: everyone present
decisions.reason: The phrase means every person there, chiefly the servants. Tamar is left alone with Amnon.

decisions.choice: set the cakes out (Balanced); served him the cakes (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not name what she poured out; Balanced and Readable name the cakes.

decisions.choice: "हर एक को मेरे पास से बाहर निकाल दो" (Literal); "सबको यहाँ से बाहर भेज दो" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The words Joseph used (Genesis 45:1, m2); Literal and Balanced use the wording of that verse in this translation.

decisions.choice: "Выведите всех от меня" (Literal); "Пусть все выйдут отсюда" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: These are the words Joseph used (meaning m2); Literal and Balanced use the same Russian words as Genesis 45:1 does in this translation, so that the echo is heard.

decisions.choice: "皆をわたしのもとから出て行かせよ" (L)
decisions.reason: The words Joseph used (m2); L matches GEN 45:1 L.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַמְנ֜וֹן אֶל־תָּמָ֗ר הָבִ֤יאִי הַבִּרְיָה֙ הַחֶ֔דֶר וְאֶבְרֶ֖ה מִיָּדֵ֑ךְ וַתִּקַּ֣ח תָּמָ֗ר אֶת־הַלְּבִבוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔תָה וַתָּבֵ֛א לְאַמְנ֥וֹן אָחִ֖יהָ הֶחָֽדְרָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Amnon to Tamar, bring the food [into] the chamber, and I will eat from your hand. And took Tamar the cakes which she had made and brought [them] to Amnon her brother to the chamber.

en.L: And Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food into the inner room, so that I may eat from your hand." And Tamar took the cakes that she had made and brought [them] to Amnon her brother into the inner room.
en.B: Amnon then told Tamar, "Bring the food in here to the bedroom, and I will eat from your hand." So Tamar took the cakes she had made and brought them to her brother Amnon in the bedroom.
en.R: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food into my bedroom. I want you to feed me." So Tamar took the cakes she had made and brought them to her brother Amnon in his bedroom.

es.L: Y Amnón dijo a Tamar: «Trae la comida a la alcoba, para que yo coma de tu mano». Y Tamar tomó las tortas que había hecho y [las] llevó a Amnón su hermano, a la alcoba.
es.B: Entonces Amnón le dijo a Tamar: «Trae la comida aquí al dormitorio, y comeré de tu mano». Tamar tomó las tortas que había hecho y se las llevó a su hermano Amnón al dormitorio.
es.R: Entonces Amnón le dijo a Tamar: «Trae la comida a mi dormitorio. Quiero que tú me des de comer». Tamar tomó las tortas que había hecho y se las llevó a su hermano Amnón a su dormitorio.

fr.L: Et Amnon dit à Tamar : « Apporte la nourriture dans la chambre, et je mangerai de ta main. » Et Tamar prit les gâteaux qu’elle avait faits et [les] apporta à Amnon son frère dans la chambre.
fr.B: Amnon dit alors à Tamar : « Apporte le repas ici, dans la chambre, et je mangerai de ta main. » Tamar prit les gâteaux qu’elle avait préparés et les apporta à son frère Amnon dans la chambre.
fr.R: Puis Amnon a dit à Tamar : « Apporte le repas dans ma chambre. Je veux que tu me donnes à manger. » Tamar a donc pris les gâteaux qu’elle avait faits et les a apportés à son frère Amnon, dans sa chambre.

sw.L: Amnoni akamwambia Tamari, "Lete chakula chumbani, nami nitakula kutoka mkononi mwako." Tamari akaichukua mikate aliyokuwa ameitengeneza, akamletea Amnoni ndugu yake chumbani.
sw.B: Kisha Amnoni akamwambia Tamari, "Lete chakula humu chumbani mwangu, nami nitakula kutoka mkononi mwako." Basi Tamari akaichukua mikate aliyoitengeneza, akamletea ndugu yake Amnoni chumbani.
sw.R: Kisha Amnoni akamwambia Tamari, "Lete chakula chumbani mwangu. Nataka unilishe wewe mwenyewe." Basi Tamari akaichukua mikate aliyoitengeneza, akampelekea ndugu yake Amnoni chumbani mwake.

vi.L: Am-nôn nói với Ta-ma: "Hãy đem món ăn vào phòng trong, để anh ăn từ tay em." Ta-ma lấy những cái bánh nàng đã làm và đem vào phòng trong cho Am-nôn anh mình.
