vi.B: Am-nôn bảo Ta-ma: "Em đem món ăn vào phòng ngủ đây, để anh ăn từ tay em." Ta-ma lấy những cái bánh mình đã làm, đem vào phòng ngủ cho Am-nôn anh mình.
vi.R: Rồi Am-nôn nói với Ta-ma: "Em đem thức ăn vào phòng ngủ của anh. Anh muốn em đút cho anh ăn." Vậy Ta-ma lấy những cái bánh mình đã làm và đem vào phòng ngủ cho Am-nôn anh mình.

ko.L: 암논이 다말에게 말했다. "음식을 안방으로 가져오너라. 내가 네 손에서 받아먹겠다." 다말은 자기가 만든 빵을 들고 안방에 있는 자기 오라버니 암논에게 가져갔다.
ko.B: 그러자 암논이 다말에게 말했다. "음식을 이 침실로 가져오너라. 네 손에서 받아먹겠다." 다말은 자기가 만든 빵을 들고 침실에 있는 오라버니 암논에게 가져갔다.
ko.R: 암논이 다말에게 말했다. "음식을 내 침실로 가져와라. 네가 먹여 주었으면 좋겠다." 그래서 다말은 자기가 만든 빵을 들고 침실에 있는 오라버니 암논에게 갔다.

pt.L: E Amnom disse a Tamar: "Traga a comida para o quarto interior, para que eu coma da sua mão." E Tamar pegou os bolos que tinha feito e [os] levou a Amnom, seu irmão, no quarto interior.
pt.B: Então Amnom disse a Tamar: "Traga a comida aqui para o quarto, e eu vou comer da sua mão." Tamar pegou os bolos que tinha feito e os levou ao seu irmão Amnom, no quarto.
pt.R: Então Amnom disse a Tamar: "Traga a comida para o meu quarto. Quero que você me dê de comer." Tamar pegou os bolos que tinha feito e os levou ao seu irmão Amnom, no quarto dele.

am.L: አምኖንም ትዕማርን፦ «ከእጅሽ እበላ ዘንድ ምግቡን ወደ እልፍኙ አምጪ» አላት። ትዕማርም ያደረገችውን እንጎቻ ወስዳ ወደ እልፍኙ ወደ ወንድሟ ወደ አምኖን አመጣች።
am.B: ከዚያም አምኖን ትዕማርን፦ «ምግቡን ወደዚህ ወደ መኝታ ቤቱ አምጪ፤ ከእጅሽም እበላለሁ» አላት። ትዕማርም የጋገረችውን እንጎቻ ወስዳ በመኝታ ቤቱ ወዳለው ወደ ወንድሟ ወደ አምኖን አመጣች።
am.R: ከዚያም አምኖን ትዕማርን፦ «ምግቡን ወደ መኝታ ቤቴ አምጪ። አንቺ ራስሽ እንድታበይኝ እፈልጋለሁ» አላት። ስለዚህ ትዕማር የጋገረችውን እንጎቻ ወስዳ በመኝታ ቤቱ ወዳለው ወደ ወንድሟ ወደ አምኖን አመጣች።

hi.L: और अम्नोन ने तामार से कहा, "भोजन को भीतरी कोठरी में ले आओ, कि मैं तुम्हारे हाथ से खाऊँ।" और तामार अपने बनाए हुए पूए लेकर भीतरी कोठरी में अपने भाई अम्नोन के पास ले आई।
hi.B: तब अम्नोन ने तामार से कहा, "भोजन यहाँ शयनकक्ष में ले आओ, और मैं तुम्हारे हाथ से खाऊँगा।" इसलिए तामार अपने बनाए हुए पूए लेकर शयनकक्ष में अपने भाई अम्नोन के पास ले आई।
hi.R: फिर अम्नोन ने तामार से कहा, "खाना मेरे सोने के कमरे में ले आओ। मैं चाहता हूँ कि तुम मुझे अपने हाथ से खिलाओ।" तो तामार अपने बनाए हुए पूए लेकर उसके सोने के कमरे में अपने भाई अम्नोन के पास ले गई।

ru.L: И сказал Амнон Фамари: «Принеси еду во внутреннюю комнату, и я поем из твоей руки.» И взяла Фамарь лепёшки, которые сделала, и принесла [их] Амнону, своему брату, во внутреннюю комнату.
ru.B: Тогда Амнон сказал Фамари: «Принеси еду сюда, в спальню, и я поем из твоих рук.» Фамарь взяла лепёшки, которые испекла, и принесла их своему брату Амнону в спальню.
ru.R: Тогда Амнон сказал Фамари: «Принеси еду ко мне в спальню. Я хочу, чтобы ты покормила меня.» Фамарь взяла лепёшки, которые испекла, и принесла их своему брату Амнону в спальню.

ja.L: アムノンはタマルに言った。「食べ物を奥の部屋に持って来てくれ。わたしはおまえの手から食べたい。」タマルは自分が作った菓子を取って、奥の部屋にいる兄アムノンのところに持って行った。
ja.B: アムノンはタマルに言った。「食べ物を寝室に持って来てくれ。おまえの手から食べたいのだ。」タマルは作った菓子を取って、寝室にいる兄アムノンのもとに持って行った。
ja.R: それからアムノンはタマルに言いました。「食べ物をわたしの寝室に持って来てくれ。おまえに食べさせてほしいのだ。」そこでタマルは、作ったお菓子を持って、寝室にいる兄アムノンのところに行きました。

uk.L: І сказав Амнон до Тамар: «Принеси їжу до внутрішньої кімнати, щоб я поїв з твоєї руки.» І взяла Тамар коржі, які зробила, і принесла Амнонові, своєму братові, до внутрішньої кімнати.
uk.B: Тоді Амнон сказав Тамар: «Принеси їжу сюди, до спальні, і я поїм з твоєї руки.» Тож Тамар узяла коржі, які зробила, і принесла їх своєму братові Амнонові до спальні.
uk.R: Тоді Амнон сказав Тамар: «Принеси їжу до моєї спальні. Я хочу, щоб ти мене нагодувала.» Тож Тамар узяла коржі, які зробила, і принесла їх своєму братові Амнонові до його спальні.

decisions.choice: the chamber: an inner, private room, here his bedroom
decisions.reason: The word names a room further inside a house, out of sight (Genesis 43:30). With Amnon lying sick, it is the room where he slept (Exodus 7:28 speaks of a "bedroom" with the same word).

decisions.choice: Amnon her brother: the narrator keeps calling him her brother
decisions.reason: "Her brother" is repeated through the story (verses 4, 7, 8, 10, 12). The repetition makes plain the bond Amnon is about to violate.

decisions.choice: the bedroom
decisions.reason: Literal says "inner room", the general sense; Balanced and Readable say "bedroom", the room meant here. Readable puts "eat from your hand" as "feed me".

decisions.choice: la alcoba (L); el dormitorio (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal uses 'alcoba', an inner private room, for the general sense (m1); Balanced and Readable name the room meant here, 'dormitorio', as the English says 'bedroom'.

decisions.choice: "भीतरी कोठरी" (Literal); "शयनकक्ष" (Balanced); "सोने का कमरा" (Readable); "अपने भाई अम्नोन"
decisions.reason: An inner, private room, here his bedroom (m1). The narrator keeps calling him her brother (m2), at every level.

decisions.choice: "во внутреннюю комнату" (Literal); "в спальню" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: An inner, private room, here his bedroom (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: cheder "奥の部屋" (L), "寝室" (B, R)
decisions.reason: An inner, private room, here his bedroom (m1).

decisions.choice: 'achiha "兄アムノン" kept each time the narrator says "her brother"
decisions.reason: The narrator keeps calling him her brother (m2).

source.text: וַתַּגֵּ֥שׁ אֵלָ֖יו לֶֽאֱכֹ֑ל וַיַּֽחֲזֶק־בָּהּ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָ֔הּ בּ֛וֹאִי שִׁכְבִ֥י עִמִּ֖י אֲחוֹתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And she brought [them] near to him to eat, and he seized her and said to her, come, lie with me, my sister.

en.L: And she brought [them] near to him to eat, and he seized her and said to her, "Come, lie with me, my sister."
en.B: But when she brought them close for him to eat, he grabbed her and said to her, "Come, lie with me, my sister."
en.R: But when she held the food out to him, he grabbed her. He said, "Come to bed with me, my sister."

es.L: Y ella [se las] acercó para que comiera, y él la agarró y le dijo: «Ven, acuéstate conmigo, hermana mía».
es.B: Pero cuando ella se las acercó para que comiera, él la agarró y le dijo: «Ven, acuéstate conmigo, hermana mía».
es.R: Pero cuando ella le acercó la comida, él la agarró. Le dijo: «Ven a la cama conmigo, hermana mía».

fr.L: Et elle [les] lui présenta pour qu’il mange, et il la saisit et lui dit : « Viens, couche avec moi, ma sœur. »
fr.B: Mais quand elle les approcha de lui pour qu’il mange, il l’empoigna et lui dit : « Viens, couche avec moi, ma sœur. »
fr.R: Mais quand elle lui a tendu la nourriture, il l’a attrapée. Il lui a dit : « Viens au lit avec moi, ma sœur. »

sw.L: Akamsogezea ili ale, naye akamkamata akamwambia, "Njoo, ulale nami, dada yangu."
sw.B: Lakini alipomsogezea ili ale, akamshika kwa nguvu akamwambia, "Njoo ulale nami, dada yangu."
sw.R: Lakini alipomnyooshea chakula, akamkamata. Akasema, "Njoo kitandani pamoja nami, dada yangu."

vi.L: Nàng đem [bánh] đến gần chàng để chàng ăn, thì chàng nắm lấy nàng và nói với nàng: "Hãy đến nằm với anh, em gái của anh."
vi.B: Nhưng khi nàng đưa bánh đến gần cho chàng ăn, chàng nắm chặt lấy nàng và nói: "Em gái của anh, hãy đến nằm với anh."
vi.R: Nhưng khi nàng đưa thức ăn cho chàng, chàng chụp lấy nàng và nói: "Em gái của anh, hãy lên giường với anh."

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 그에게 먹도록 가까이 가져가자, 그가 그 여자를 붙잡고 말했다. "와서 나와 함께 눕자, 내 누이야."
ko.B: 그런데 다말이 먹을 것을 가까이 내밀자, 암논은 다말을 붙잡고 말했다. "누이야, 이리 와서 나와 함께 눕자."
ko.R: 다말이 음식을 내밀자 암논이 다말을 꽉 붙잡았다. 그리고 말했다. "누이야, 나와 같이 자자."

pt.L: E ela [os] aproximou dele para [que] comesse, e ele a agarrou e lhe disse: "Venha, deite-se comigo, minha irmã."
pt.B: Mas, quando ela os aproximou para que ele comesse, ele a agarrou e lhe disse: "Venha, deite-se comigo, minha irmã."
pt.R: Mas, quando ela ofereceu a comida a ele, Amnom a agarrou. Ele disse: "Venha para a cama comigo, minha irmã."

am.L: ይበላም ዘንድ ወደ እርሱ አቀረበች፤ እርሱም ያዛት፤ «እኅቴ ሆይ፣ ነዪ፣ ከእኔ ጋር ተኚ» አላት።
am.B: እንዲበላ ባቀረበችለት ጊዜ ግን ያዛትና፦ «እኅቴ ሆይ፣ ነዪ፣ ከእኔ ጋር ተኚ» አላት።
am.R: ምግቡን በሰጠችው ጊዜ ግን ያዛት። «እኅቴ ሆይ፣ ነዪ፣ ከእኔ ጋር ተኚ» አላት።

hi.L: और जब वह उन्हें उसके पास खाने को ले गई, तो उसने उसे पकड़ लिया और उससे कहा, "आओ, मेरे साथ सोओ, मेरी बहन।"
hi.B: पर जब वह उन्हें उसके पास ले गई कि वह खाए, तो उसने उसे पकड़ लिया और कहा, "आओ, मेरे साथ सोओ, मेरी बहन।"
hi.R: पर जब उसने खाना उसकी ओर बढ़ाया, तो उसने उसे पकड़ लिया। उसने कहा, "आओ, मेरे साथ बिस्तर पर चलो, मेरी बहन।"

ru.L: И поднесла она [их] к нему, чтобы он ел, а он схватил её и сказал ей: «Иди, ложись со мной, сестра моя.»
ru.B: Но когда она поднесла их к нему, чтобы он поел, он схватил её и сказал: «Иди ко мне, ложись со мной, сестра моя.»
ru.R: Но когда она протянула ему еду, он схватил её. Он сказал: «Ложись со мной в постель, сестра.»

ja.L: 彼女が食べさせようと彼に近づけると、彼は彼女をつかんで言った。「来て、わたしと寝なさい、わたしの妹よ。」
ja.B: ところが、彼女が食べさせようとしてそばに差し出すと、彼は彼女をつかまえて言った。「さあ、わたしと寝てくれ、妹よ。」
ja.R: ところが、タマルがお菓子を差し出すと、アムノンは彼女をつかまえて言いました。「さあ、わたしと寝てくれ、妹よ。」

uk.L: І піднесла вона йому їсти, а він схопив її і сказав їй: «Ходи, ляж зі мною, моя сестро.»
uk.B: Але коли вона піднесла їх, щоб він поїв, він схопив її й сказав їй: «Ходи, ляж зі мною, моя сестро.»
uk.R: Але коли вона простягла йому їжу, він схопив її. Він сказав: «Ходи до мене в ліжко, моя сестро.»

decisions.choice: seized her: took hold of her by force
decisions.reason: The verb means to grasp firmly. It is the verb of the law on a man who seizes a woman in the countryside (Deuteronomy 22:25).

decisions.choice: come, lie with me: the words of Potiphar's wife
decisions.reason: Potiphar's wife said the same words when she seized Joseph (Genesis 39:7, 12). Joseph got away; Tamar cannot.

decisions.choice: my sister: the relationship the law forbade
decisions.reason: The law forbade sexual relations with a sister or half-sister (Leviticus 18:9, 11; 20:17; Deuteronomy 27:22). Amnon calls her "my sister" in the very words that ask for what the law forbids.

decisions.choice: Come to bed with me
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what Amnon is asking, in words that a young reader can follow without being graphic.

decisions.choice: deite-se comigo
decisions.reason: Amnon speaks the words of Potiphar's wife (m2), so Literal and Balanced keep "Deite-se comigo", the wording of Genesis 39:7 in Portuguese Literal. Readable says plainly what he asks, as the English does, without being graphic.

decisions.choice: "मेरे साथ सोओ" (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: The words of Potiphar's wife (Genesis 39:7, 12, m2), in the "तुम" form of this scene; "मेरी बहन" keeps the relationship the law forbade (m3).

decisions.choice: "तुम" between Amnon and Tamar
alternatives: "आप" from Tamar to her elder brother
decisions.reason: Brother and sister say "तुम" to each other (Pentateuch note). Tamar's plea in verses 12-13 keeps "तुम", which sounds close and urgent in Hindi.

decisions.choice: "ложись со мной"
decisions.reason: The words of Potiphar's wife (meaning m2); Russian uses the words of Genesis 39:12 in this translation, "Ложись со мной".

decisions.choice: "сестра моя"
decisions.reason: Russian puts the possessive after the noun in address, as a family word of tenderness; Readable says "сестра".

decisions.choice: "来て、わたしと寝なさい" (L)
decisions.reason: The words of Potiphar's wife (m2); L echoes GEN 39:7 L "わたしと寝なさい".

source.text: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אַל־אָחִי֙ אַל־תְּעַנֵּ֔נִי כִּ֛י לֹא־יֵֽעָשֶׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַֽל־תַּעֲשֵׂ֖ה אֶת־הַנְּבָלָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And she said to him, no, my brother, do not humble me, for not it is done thus in Israel; do not do the disgraceful thing, this.

en.L: And she said to him, "No, my brother! Do not humble me, for such a thing is not done in Israel. Do not do this disgraceful thing.
en.B: "No, my brother!" she said to him. "Do not violate me! Such a thing is not done in Israel. Do not do this outrageous thing.
en.R: "No, my brother!" she said. "Do not force me! A thing like this must never be done in Israel. Do not do this shameful thing.

es.L: Y ella le dijo: «¡No, hermano mío! No me humilles, porque no se hace así en Israel. No cometas esta infamia.
es.B: «¡No, hermano mío!», le dijo ella. «¡No me deshonres! Eso no se hace en Israel. No cometas esta atrocidad.
es.R: «¡No, hermano mío!», le dijo ella. «¡No me fuerces! Algo así no debe hacerse nunca en Israel. No hagas esta cosa tan vergonzosa.

fr.L: Et elle lui dit : « Non, mon frère ! Ne m’humilie pas, car cela ne se fait pas en Israël. Ne commets pas cette infamie.
fr.B: « Non, mon frère ! lui dit-elle. Ne me fais pas violence ! Cela ne se fait pas en Israël. Ne commets pas cette infamie.
fr.R: « Non, mon frère ! a-t-elle dit. Ne me force pas ! Une chose pareille ne doit jamais se faire en Israël. Ne fais pas cette chose honteuse.

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Hapana, ndugu yangu! Usinitweze, kwa maana jambo kama hili halitendwi katika Israeli. Usitende jambo hili la aibu.
sw.B: Akamwambia, "Hapana, ndugu yangu! Usinichafue! Jambo kama hili halitendwi katika Israeli. Usitende uovu huu wa aibu.
sw.R: Akasema, "Hapana, ndugu yangu! Usinilazimishe! Jambo kama hili halipaswi kutendwa kamwe katika Israeli. Usifanye jambo hili la aibu.

vi.L: Nàng nói với chàng: "Không, anh ơi! Đừng làm nhục em, vì không ai làm như thế trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Đừng làm điều ô nhục này.
vi.B: Nàng nói: "Không, anh ơi! Đừng cưỡng bức em! Trong Y-sơ-ra-ên không ai làm chuyện như thế. Đừng làm điều đồi bại này.
vi.R: Nàng nói: "Không, anh ơi! Đừng ép em! Trong Y-sơ-ra-ên không bao giờ được làm chuyện như thế. Đừng làm điều đáng xấu hổ này.

ko.L: 그 여자가 그에게 말했다. "안 돼요, 오라버니! 나를 욕보이지 마세요. 이스라엘에서는 이런 일을 하지 않아요. 이런 수치스러운 일을 하지 마세요.

ru.R: «Нет, брат мой!» — сказала она. — «Не принуждай меня! Такого никогда не должно быть в Израиле. Не делай этого позорного дела.

uk.B: «Ні, мій брате!» — сказала вона йому. — «Не збезчещуй мене! Так не роблять в Ізраїлі. Не чини цієї ганьби.
uk.R: «Ні, мій брате!» — сказала вона. — «Не силуй мене! Такого ніколи не можна робити в Ізраїлі. Не роби цієї ганебної речі.

decisions.choice: humble me: violate me, take my honor by force
decisions.reason: The verb means to humble, degrade or violate. It is used of the rape of Dinah (Genesis 34:2) and in the law on a man who seizes a woman (Deuteronomy 22:29). Here it names the wrong Amnon is about to do to her; it returns in verses 14, 22 and 32.

decisions.choice: disgraceful thing: an outrage that shames the whole people
decisions.reason: The word is used of a gross wrong, often a sexual one, that breaks the bonds of the community: the rape of Dinah (Genesis 34:7), the outrage at Gibeah (Judges 19:23; 20:6) and the case in Deuteronomy 22:21.

decisions.choice: it is not done thus in Israel: Tamar appeals to the people's own standard
decisions.reason: Her words echo what Jacob's sons said after Dinah was raped: "such a thing is not done" (Genesis 34:7). Tamar reminds Amnon that this is not just a private act but a crime against Israel's way of life.

decisions.choice: humble (Literal); violate (Balanced); force (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "humble" and Balanced says "violate", as in Deuteronomy 22:29, where a man also takes hold of the woman. Readable says "force" here, and "rape" when the act is told (verses 14, 22, 32), since the story makes plain that force was used (as Judges 20:5 says "raped"); Deuteronomy 22 says "dishonored" at Readable, where the law covers more than one case.

decisions.choice: outrageous thing (Balanced); shameful thing (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 22:21, Balanced says "outrageous" and Readable says "shameful". Literal keeps "disgraceful", as in Genesis 34:7.

decisions.choice: "humilier" (L); "faire violence" (B); "forcer" (R)
decisions.reason: The same verb is followed through the chapter: Literal keeps the Hebrew image, Balanced and Readable say what is meant (m1), as the English does with "humble", "violate", "force".

decisions.choice: humillar (L); deshonrar (B); forzar (R), and 'violar' at R where the act is told (verses 14, 22, 32)
decisions.reason: As the English decision (r-en-1): Literal keeps the Hebrew verb's 'humble'; Balanced says 'deshonrar', the wrong done to her honor; Readable says 'forzar' here and 'violar' where the act is told, since the story makes plain that force was used.

decisions.choice: infamia (L); atrocidad (B); cosa tan vergonzosa (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names an outrage that shames the whole people (m2). Spanish 'infamia' keeps the disgrace at Literal; Balanced 'atrocidad' follows the English 'outrageous thing'; Readable says plainly that it is shameful.

decisions.choice: usinitweze (L); usinichafue (B); usinilazimishe (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "humble" (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "kutweza", to humiliate; Balanced "kuchafua", to violate her honour; Readable says plainly that it would be by force. The same three verbs are used for this act through the chapter, with "kubaka" where the English Readable says "rape".

decisions.choice: "làm nhục" (L); "cưỡng bức" (B); "ép" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to humble or violate (meaning decision). Literal keeps the sense of shaming, Balanced names the force, and Readable keeps a plain word that a young reader can follow without being graphic, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Tamar speaks to Amnon in the polite style (해요체) with "오라버니"; he speaks to her in the plain style (해라체)
decisions.reason: A younger sister to an older brother; the polite style keeps her plea personal and urgent, where the formal style would sound like a petition at court.

decisions.choice: não me humilhe (L); não me violente (B); não me force (R); the same verb in verses 14, 22 and 32
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "humilhar", the verb of Genesis 34:2 in Portuguese Literal. Balanced says "violentar", the plain Portuguese verb for taking a woman by force, as the English says "violate"; Readable says "forçar" here and "estuprar" when the act is told (verses 14, 22, 32), as the English says "force" and "rape". The words are plain and sober at every level, as in the English. "Desonrar" names the shame rather than the act.

decisions.choice: esta infâmia (L, B); essa coisa vergonhosa (R)
decisions.reason: Nevalah (m2) keeps the wording of Genesis 34:7 and Judges 19:23 in Portuguese, "infâmia" at Literal and Balanced and "coisa vergonhosa" at Readable, so that the links with Dinah and Gibeah can be heard. "Loucura" would read as madness.

decisions.choice: "humble": "भ्रष्ट करना" (Literal); "इज़्ज़त लूटना" (Balanced); "ज़बरदस्ती करना" (Readable)
decisions.reason: To take a woman's honour by force (m1). The English varies the verb by level in the same way. The same Hindi verbs at each level in verses 14, 22 and 32 ("बलात्कार करना" at Readable where the English says "rape").

decisions.choice: nebalah: "मूर्खता का घिनौना काम" (Literal); "घिनौना काम" (Balanced); "शर्मनाक काम" (Readable)
decisions.reason: An outrage that shames the whole people (m2), worded as Genesis 34:7 and Judges 19:23 in this translation, where the same word is used of sexual outrage.

decisions.choice: "не унижай меня" (Literal); "не бесчесть меня" (Balanced); "не принуждай меня" (Readable)
decisions.reason: To humble is to violate, to take a woman's honour by force (meaning m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew verb "унижать"; Balanced says "бесчестить"; Readable says "принуждать". The same wording at each level in verses 14, 22 and 32, where Readable says "изнасиловать" for the act, as the English "raped".

decisions.choice: "позорного безумия" (Literal); "гнусного дела" (Balanced); "позорного дела" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Nevalah is an outrage that shames the whole people (meaning m2). Literal says "безумие", the Russian Bible's word for this folly, so that verse 13's "безумцев" (nevalim) stays one family of words.

decisions.choice: one quotation broken by "— сказала она ему, —"
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable break Tamar's speech with a verb of saying and count two quotations; Russian keeps two pairs of marks, as the style guide settles.

decisions.choice: 'innah "辱める" (L, B), "無理やり…する" (R); nevalah "恥ずべき愚かなこと" (L), "恥ずべきこと" (B), "恥ずかしいこと" (R)
decisions.reason: As JDG 19:23-24 and GEN 34:7, where the same outrage is named.

decisions.choice: Tamar to Amnon in です・ます, calling him "わたしの兄よ" (L), "お兄さま" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A younger sister pleading with an older brother; Amnon speaks to her plainly (妹よ, おまえ).

decisions.choice: "принижувати" (L), "збезчестити" (B), "зґвалтувати" or "силувати" (R)
decisions.reason: The English levels move from the Hebrew picture to the plain fact of the crime; the Ukrainian follows them.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֗י אָ֤נָה אוֹלִיךְ֙ אֶת־חֶרְפָּתִ֔י וְאַתָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֛ה כְּאַחַ֥ד הַנְּבָלִ֖ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּה֙ דַּבֶּר־נָ֣א אֶל־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִמְנָעֵ֖נִי מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I, where will I carry my disgrace? And you, you will be like one of the fools in Israel. And now speak please to the king, for not will he withhold me from you.

en.L: And I, where would I carry my disgrace? And you, you would be like one of the disgraceful fools in Israel. And now, please speak to the king, for he will not withhold me from you."
en.B: As for me, where could I go with my shame? And you would be counted among the outrageous fools in Israel. Now please, speak to the king. He will not keep me from you."
en.R: Where could I go? I would have to live with this disgrace. And people would think of you as one of the worst fools in Israel. Please, just talk to the king. He will let you marry me."

es.L: Y yo, ¿adónde llevaría mi deshonra? Y tú, tú serías como uno de los infames necios de Israel. Y ahora, te ruego que hables al rey, porque él no me negará a ti».
es.B: En cuanto a mí, ¿adónde podría ir con mi vergüenza? Y tú serías contado entre los infames necios de Israel. Ahora, por favor, habla con el rey. Él no me negará a ti».
es.R: ¿Adónde podría ir yo? Tendría que vivir con esta vergüenza. Y la gente te tendría por uno de los peores necios de Israel. Por favor, simplemente habla con el rey. Él te dejará casarte conmigo».

fr.L: Et moi, où porterais-je ma honte ? Et toi, tu serais comme l’un des insensés en Israël. Et maintenant, parle donc au roi, car il ne me refusera pas à toi. »
fr.B: Moi, où irais-je avec ma honte ? Et toi, tu passerais pour l’un des pires insensés d’Israël. Maintenant, je t’en prie, parle au roi. Il ne refusera pas de me donner à toi. »
fr.R: Où pourrais-je aller ? Je devrais vivre avec cette honte. Et les gens te regarderaient comme l’un des pires insensés d’Israël. S’il te plaît, parle simplement au roi. Il te permettra de m’épouser. »

sw.L: Nami, aibu yangu nitaipeleka wapi? Nawe, utakuwa kama mmoja wa wapumbavu katika Israeli. Basi sasa, tafadhali sema na mfalme, kwa maana hatakunyima mimi."
sw.B: Mimi ningeenda wapi na aibu yangu? Nawe ungehesabiwa miongoni mwa wapumbavu waovu kabisa katika Israeli. Sasa tafadhali, sema na mfalme. Hatakunyima mimi."
sw.R: Ningeenda wapi? Ningeishi na aibu hii maisha yangu yote. Na watu wangekuona wewe kuwa mmoja wa wapumbavu wabaya kabisa katika Israeli. Tafadhali, zungumza tu na mfalme. Atakuruhusu unioe."

vi.L: Còn em, em sẽ mang nỗi nhục của em đi đâu? Còn anh, anh sẽ như một trong những kẻ đồi bại trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vậy bây giờ, xin anh hãy nói với vua, vì vua sẽ không giữ em lại không cho anh đâu."
vi.B: Còn em, em biết mang nỗi nhục này đi đâu? Còn anh, anh sẽ bị xem như một kẻ đồi bại trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Bây giờ, xin anh hãy nói với vua. Vua sẽ không từ chối gả em cho anh đâu."
vi.R: Em biết đi đâu bây giờ? Em sẽ phải sống với nỗi nhục này suốt đời. Còn anh, người ta sẽ coi anh là một trong những kẻ ngu xuẩn tệ hại nhất trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Xin anh cứ nói với vua. Vua sẽ cho anh cưới em."

ko.L: 그리고 나는, 내 수치를 어디로 지고 가겠어요? 그리고 오라버니는 이스라엘에서 어리석은 자들 가운데 하나처럼 될 거예요. 그러니 이제 부디 임금님께 말씀드리세요. 임금님은 나를 오라버니에게 주기를 거절하지 않으실 거예요."
ko.B: 나는 이 수치를 안고 어디로 가겠어요? 그리고 오라버니는 이스라엘에서 몹쓸 바보들 가운데 하나로 여겨질 거예요. 그러니 제발 임금님께 말씀드리세요. 임금님은 나를 오라버니에게 주기를 마다하지 않으실 거예요."
ko.R: 내가 어디로 가겠어요? 나는 평생 이 수치를 안고 살아야 해요. 사람들은 오라버니를 이스라엘에서 가장 못된 바보로 여길 거예요. 제발 임금님께 말씀만 드리세요. 임금님은 오라버니가 나와 결혼하게 해 주실 거예요."

pt.B: Quanto a mim, para onde eu iria com a minha vergonha? E você seria contado entre os insensatos infames de Israel. Agora, por favor, fale com o rei. Ele não vai me negar a você."

am.L: እኔስ ኀፍረቴን ወዴት እሸከማለሁ? አንተም በእስራኤል ካሉ ሰነፎች እንደ አንዱ ትሆናለህ። አሁንም እባክህ ንጉሡን ተናገረው፤ ከአንተ አይከለክለኝምና።»
am.B: እኔስ ኀፍረቴን ይዤ ወዴት እሄዳለሁ? አንተም በእስራኤል ከሚገኙ ከክፉ ሰነፎች እንደ አንዱ ትቆጠራለህ። አሁንም እባክህ ንጉሡን ጠይቀው፤ ከአንተ አይከለክለኝም።»

hi.L: और मैं, मैं अपनी नामधराई लेकर कहाँ जाऊँ? और तुम, तुम इस्राएल के घिनौने मूर्खों में से एक के समान ठहरोगे। और अब, कृपया राजा से बात करो, क्योंकि वह मुझे तुमसे न रोकेंगे।"
hi.B: मैं अपनी लज्जा लेकर कहाँ जाऊँगी? और तुम इस्राएल के महामूर्खों में गिने जाओगे। अब कृपया राजा से बात करो। वे मुझे तुमसे दूर नहीं रखेंगे।"
hi.R: मैं कहाँ जाऊँगी? मुझे सारी ज़िंदगी यह कलंक ढोना पड़ेगा। और लोग तुम्हें इस्राएल के सबसे बुरे मूर्खों में से एक समझेंगे। कृपया, बस राजा से बात करो। वे तुम्हारा विवाह मुझसे होने देंगे।"

ru.L: А я — куда я понесу свой позор? А ты — ты будешь как один из позорных безумцев в Израиле. А теперь поговори, прошу, с царём, ведь он не откажет тебе во мне.»
ru.B: А мне куда деться со своим позором? А тебя сочтут одним из гнусных безумцев в Израиле. Лучше поговори с царём. Он не откажет тебе во мне.»
ru.R: Куда я денусь? Мне придётся жить с этим позором. А люди будут считать тебя одним из худших негодяев в Израиле. Прошу, просто поговори с царём. Он позволит тебе жениться на мне.»

ja.L: このわたしは、自分の恥をどこへ持って行けるでしょうか？そしてあなたは、イスラエルの愚か者の一人のようになるでしょう。今、どうか王に話してください。王はわたしをあなたから引き離しはしないでしょう。」
ja.B: わたしは、この恥を負ってどこへ行けるでしょうか？あなたも、イスラエルで恥知らずな愚か者の一人と見なされるでしょう。どうか、王に話してください。王はわたしをあなたに与えることを拒まないでしょう。」
ja.R: わたしは、どこへ行けばいいのですか？ずっとこの恥を背負って生きなければなりません。お兄さまも、イスラエルでいちばんひどい愚か者だと思われるでしょう。お願いです。王さまに話してください。王さまは、きっとわたしをお兄さまと結婚させてくださいます。」

uk.L: А я, куди я понесу свою ганьбу? А ти будеш, як один із безумних в Ізраїлі. А тепер, прошу, поговори з царем, бо він не відмовить тобі в мені.»
uk.B: Куди я піду зі своєю ганьбою? А тебе вважатимуть одним із безумців Ізраїля. Тепер, прошу, поговори з царем. Він не відмовить тобі в мені.»
uk.R: Куди я подінуся? Мені доведеться жити з цією ганьбою. А люди вважатимуть тебе одним з найгірших дурнів в Ізраїлі. Прошу, просто поговори з царем. Він дозволить тобі одружитися зі мною.»

decisions.choice: where would I carry my disgrace: there would be nowhere I could go with my shame
decisions.reason: The question expects no answer. A woman raped and then left unmarried bore a shame that would follow her for life; verse 20 shows that this is what happened.

decisions.choice: the fools: people who are morally reckless and shameless
decisions.reason: The word is related to "disgraceful thing" in verse 12. It does not mean dull or slow, but someone who acts without regard for God or for others, like Nabal, whose name means "fool" (1 Samuel 25:25). Amnon, the heir to the throne, would be counted among the worst of men.

decisions.choice: he will not withhold me from you: the king would let you marry me
decisions.reason: The law forbade marriage with a half-sister (Leviticus 18:9, 11; 20:17), though in the time of the ancestors Abraham had married his (Genesis 20:12). The text does not say whether Tamar thought David would really allow it or was saying anything she could to escape. Either way, she offers Amnon a lawful way and he refuses it.

decisions.choice: I would have to live with this disgrace; He will let you marry me
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the question into a question and a statement of what it implies, and says plainly that "he will not withhold me from you" means marriage.

decisions.choice: "kẻ đồi bại" (L, B); "kẻ ngu xuẩn tệ hại nhất" (R) for "the fools"
decisions.reason: The word means someone morally shameless, not slow-witted (meaning decision), so Literal and Balanced use "đồi bại", which echoes "điều đồi bại" of verse 12 in Balanced; Readable follows the English "the worst fools".

decisions.choice: os infames (L); os insensatos infames (B); os homens mais desprezíveis (R)
decisions.reason: The word is related to the "infâmia" of verse 12 and means people who are shameless, not dull (m2). Literal says "infames" to keep the link with "infâmia", as the English Literal keeps "disgraceful"; Balanced adds "insensatos" for the folly, as the English "outrageous fools"; Readable says "desprezíveis", since "tolo" in Portuguese means only silly.

decisions.choice: the nevalim are "ሰነፎች" (fools), with "ክፉ" or "እጅግ የከፉ" at Balanced and Readable; the nevalah of verse 12 is "የስንፍና ነገር" (Literal) and "አሳፋሪ" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision describes people who are morally reckless and shameless, not merely foolish; "ሰነፍ" in its biblical sense keeps the link of the two Hebrew words, and the added "ክፉ" stops Readable from hearing only "lazy".

decisions.choice: "घिनौने मूर्खों" (Literal); "महामूर्खों" (Balanced); "सबसे बुरे मूर्खों" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The fool (naval) is morally reckless and shameless (m2), the word that goes with the deed of verse 12.

decisions.choice: honorific "वे", "रोकेंगे" for the king in Tamar's words
decisions.reason: Tamar speaks of her father the king with the honorific third person.

decisions.choice: "позорных безумцев" (Literal); "гнусных безумцев" (Balanced); "худших негодяев" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The nevalim are people who are morally reckless and shameless (meaning m2), not merely foolish; "безумец" is the Russian Bible word for them, and Readable says "негодяи" for the moral sense.

decisions.choice: "он не откажет тебе во мне" (Literal, Balanced); "позволит тебе жениться на мне" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The king would let you marry me (meaning m3).

decisions.choice: nevalim "愚か者" (L), "恥知らずな愚か者" (B), "いちばんひどい愚か者" (R)
decisions.reason: People who are morally reckless and shameless (m2); the same root as nevalah in 13:12.

decisions.choice: lo yimna'eni "わたしをあなたに与えることを拒まない" (B); R "結婚させてくださいます"
decisions.reason: He will not withhold me from you: the king would let you marry me (m3, uncertain).

source.text: וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ בְּקוֹלָ֑הּ וַיֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִמֶּ֨נָּה֙ וַיְעַנֶּ֔הָ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב אֹתָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: But not he was willing to listen to her voice, and he was stronger than her, and he humbled her and lay her.

en.L: But he was not willing to listen to her voice; and he was stronger than she, and he humbled her and lay with her.
en.B: But he would not listen to her. He was stronger than she was, and he violated her and lay with her by force.
en.R: But Amnon would not listen to her. He was stronger than she was, and he raped her.

es.L: Pero él no quiso escuchar su voz; y siendo más fuerte que ella, la humilló y se acostó con ella.
es.B: Pero él no quiso escucharla. Era más fuerte que ella, y la deshonró y se acostó con ella por la fuerza.
es.R: Pero Amnón no quiso escucharla. Era más fuerte que ella, y la violó.

fr.L: Mais il ne voulut pas écouter sa voix ; et il fut plus fort qu’elle, et il l’humilia et coucha avec elle.
fr.B: Mais il ne voulut pas l’écouter. Il était plus fort qu’elle ; il lui fit violence et coucha avec elle de force.
fr.R: Mais Amnon n’a pas voulu l’écouter. Il était plus fort qu’elle, et il l’a violée.

sw.L: Lakini hakutaka kusikiliza sauti yake. Naye alikuwa na nguvu kuliko yeye, akamtweza, akalala naye.
sw.B: Lakini hakutaka kumsikiliza. Kwa kuwa alikuwa na nguvu kuliko yeye, akamchafua, akalala naye kwa nguvu.
sw.R: Lakini Amnoni hakutaka kumsikiliza. Alikuwa na nguvu kuliko yeye, naye akambaka.

vi.L: Nhưng chàng không muốn nghe tiếng nàng; chàng mạnh hơn nàng, chàng làm nhục nàng và nằm với nàng.
vi.B: Nhưng chàng không chịu nghe nàng. Chàng mạnh hơn nàng, nên đã cưỡng bức nàng và nằm với nàng.
vi.R: Nhưng Am-nôn không chịu nghe Ta-ma. Chàng mạnh hơn nàng, và chàng đã cưỡng hiếp nàng.

ko.L: 그러나 그는 그 여자의 목소리를 들으려 하지 않았다. 그는 그 여자보다 힘이 세어서 그 여자를 욕보이고 그 여자와 함께 누웠다.
ko.B: 그러나 암논은 다말의 말을 들으려 하지 않았다. 그는 다말보다 힘이 세었으므로 강제로 다말을 범하고 그와 함께 누웠다.
ko.R: 그러나 암논은 다말의 말을 듣지 않았다. 암논은 다말보다 힘이 셌고, 결국 다말을 강간했다.

pt.L: Mas ele não quis ouvir a voz dela; e foi mais forte do que ela, e a humilhou, e se deitou com ela.
pt.B: Mas ele não quis ouvi-la. Era mais forte do que ela, e a violentou e se deitou com ela à força.
pt.R: Mas Amnom não quis ouvir Tamar. Ele era mais forte do que ela, e a estuprou.

am.L: እርሱ ግን ቃሏን ሊሰማ አልወደደም፤ ከእርሷም ይልቅ በረታ፤ አዋረዳትም፤ ከእርሷም ጋር ተኛ።
am.B: እርሱ ግን ሊሰማት አልፈለገም። ከእርሷ ይልቅ ብርቱ ነበረና በግድ ደፈራት፤ ከእርሷም ጋር ተኛ።
am.R: አምኖን ግን ሊሰማት አልፈለገም። ከእርሷ ይልቅ ብርቱ ነበረና አስገድዶ ደፈራት።

hi.L: पर उसने उसकी बात सुनना न चाहा; और वह उससे अधिक बलवान था, और उसने उसे भ्रष्ट किया और उसके साथ सोया।
hi.B: पर उसने उसकी एक न सुनी। वह उससे अधिक बलवान था, और उसने उसकी इज़्ज़त लूटी और ज़बरदस्ती उसके साथ सोया।
hi.R: पर अम्नोन ने उसकी नहीं सुनी। वह उससे अधिक ताक़तवर था, और उसने उसका बलात्कार किया।

ru.L: Но он не захотел слушать её голоса, и он был сильнее её, и унизил её, и лёг с ней.
ru.B: Но он не стал её слушать. Он был сильнее её, обесчестил её и взял силой.
ru.R: Но Амнон не стал её слушать. Он был сильнее её и изнасиловал её.

ja.L: しかし彼は彼女の声に聞き従おうとせず、彼女より強かったので、彼女を辱めて、彼女と寝た。
ja.B: しかし彼は彼女の言うことを聞こうとせず、力ずくで彼女を辱め、彼女と寝た。
ja.R: しかしアムノンは、タマルの言うことを聞こうとしませんでした。アムノンのほうが力が強く、彼はタマルを力ずくで犯しました。

uk.L: Але він не хотів слухати її голосу; і він був сильніший за неї, і принизив її, і ліг з нею.
uk.B: Але він не хотів її слухати. Він був сильніший за неї, і збезчестив її, силою лігши з нею.
uk.R: Але Амнон не хотів її слухати. Він був сильніший за неї і зґвалтував її.

decisions.choice: he was stronger than she: he overpowered her
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used in verse 11, "he seized her", here with "than her": he used his strength against her. The text leaves no doubt that she did not consent.

decisions.choice: humbled her and lay her: he raped her
decisions.reason: The verb "humble" is the one of verse 12. "Lay her" is written with the mark of a direct object instead of the usual "lay with her", as in the rape of Dinah (Genesis 34:2); the wording presents her as acted upon, not as a partner. Together the verbs describe rape, as in Deuteronomy 22:25.

decisions.choice: he was not willing to listen to her voice: her plea is refused
decisions.reason: Tamar had spoken at length (verses 12-13); Amnon does not answer her. The same words return in verse 16, when he refuses to listen a second time.

decisions.choice: violated her and lay with her by force (Balanced); raped her (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew verbs. Balanced keeps "violated" for the verb of verse 12 and adds "by force" for the wording of "lay her" and the overpowering just described. Readable says in one plain word what the verbs together describe. The text tells the act soberly, and the English does the same.

decisions.choice: a violentou e se deitou com ela à força (B); a estuprou (R)
decisions.reason: The text leaves no doubt that she did not consent (m1, m2). Balanced keeps "violentar" from verse 12 and adds "à força" for the overpowering, as the English adds "by force"; Readable says it in one plain, sober word, "estuprar", as the English says "raped". "Abusar" and "desonrar" would soften what the text says.

decisions.choice: "उसका बलात्कार किया" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "humbled her and lay her" means rape (m2), and the English Readable says so; Hindi Readable uses the plain word.

decisions.choice: "унизил её, и лёг с ней" (Literal); "обесчестил её и взял силой" (Balanced); "изнасиловал её" (Readable)
decisions.reason: He raped her (meaning m2). Each level says it as plainly as the English at that level; Russian Readable uses the plain modern word.

decisions.choice: "辱めて、彼女と寝た" (L), "力ずくで…辱め、彼女と寝た" (B), "力ずくで犯しました" (R)
decisions.reason: He raped her (m2); Readable names the act plainly, as the English Readable.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂנָאֶ֣הָ אַמְנ֗וֹן שִׂנְאָה֙ גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד כִּ֣י גְדוֹלָ֗ה הַשִּׂנְאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׂנֵאָ֔הּ מֵאַהֲבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲהֵבָ֑הּ וַֽיֹּאמֶר־לָ֥הּ אַמְנ֖וֹן ק֥וּמִי לֵֽכִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And hated her Amnon [with] hatred great very, for greater [was] the hatred which he hated her than the love which he had loved her. And said to her Amnon, get up, go.

en.L: And Amnon hated her [with] a very great hatred, for the hatred with which he hated her [was] greater than the love with which he had loved her. And Amnon said to her, "Get up, go!"
en.B: Then Amnon turned on her with a fierce hatred. What he felt against her now was stronger than the love he had once felt for her. "Get up and go!" Amnon said to her.
en.R: Then Amnon began to hate Tamar bitterly. His hatred for her was even stronger than his love had been. He said to her, "Get up and get out!"

es.L: Y Amnón la odió [con] un odio muy grande, porque el odio con que la odió [fue] mayor que el amor con que la había amado. Y Amnón le dijo: «¡Levántate, vete!».
es.B: Entonces Amnón se volvió contra ella con un odio feroz. Lo que ahora sentía contra ella era más fuerte que el amor que antes le había tenido. «¡Levántate y vete!», le dijo Amnón.
es.R: Entonces Amnón empezó a odiar a Tamar con amargura. Su odio por ella era aún más fuerte de lo que había sido su amor. Le dijo: «¡Levántate y lárgate!».

fr.L: Et Amnon la haït d’une très grande haine, car la haine dont il la haït [fut] plus grande que l’amour dont il l’avait aimée. Et Amnon lui dit : « Lève-toi, va-t’en ! »
fr.B: Alors Amnon se mit à la haïr violemment. La haine qu’il éprouvait maintenant pour elle était plus forte que l’amour qu’il avait eu pour elle. « Lève-toi et va-t’en ! » lui dit Amnon.
fr.R: Ensuite, Amnon s’est mis à détester Tamar profondément. Sa haine pour elle était encore plus forte que son amour d’avant. Il lui a dit : « Lève-toi et sors d’ici ! »

sw.L: Kisha Amnoni akamchukia [kwa] chuki kubwa sana, kwa maana chuki aliyomchukia ilikuwa kubwa kuliko upendo aliokuwa amempenda. Amnoni akamwambia, "Inuka, nenda!"
sw.B: Kisha Amnoni akamgeukia kwa chuki kali. Chuki aliyokuwa nayo juu yake sasa ilizidi upendo aliokuwa nao kwake hapo kwanza. Amnoni akamwambia, "Inuka uende zako!"
sw.R: Kisha Amnoni akaanza kumchukia Tamari kwa uchungu mwingi. Chuki yake kwake ilizidi hata upendo aliokuwa nao. Akamwambia, "Inuka, toka hapa!"

vi.L: Rồi Am-nôn ghét nàng [với] một sự ghét rất lớn, vì sự ghét mà chàng ghét nàng [thì] lớn hơn tình yêu mà chàng đã yêu nàng. Am-nôn nói với nàng: "Đứng dậy, đi đi!"
vi.B: Rồi Am-nôn quay ra căm ghét nàng dữ dội. Lòng căm ghét chàng dành cho nàng bây giờ còn mạnh hơn tình yêu chàng đã dành cho nàng trước đó. Am-nôn bảo nàng: "Đứng dậy, đi đi!"
vi.R: Sau đó Am-nôn bắt đầu ghét Ta-ma cay đắng. Chàng ghét nàng còn hơn lúc trước chàng yêu nàng. Chàng nói với nàng: "Đứng dậy, cút đi!"

ko.L: 그러자 암논이 그 여자를 매우 큰 미움으로 미워했다. 그가 그 여자를 미워한 미움이 그가 그 여자를 사랑했던 사랑보다 더 컸다. 그리고 암논이 그 여자에게 말했다. "일어나 가거라!"
ko.B: 그러자 암논은 다말을 몹시 미워하게 되었다. 이제 다말을 미워하는 마음이 전에 사랑하던 마음보다 더 컸다. 암논이 다말에게 말했다. "일어나서 나가거라!"
ko.R: 그러자 암논은 다말을 지독하게 미워하기 시작했다. 다말을 미워하는 마음이 전에 사랑하던 마음보다 훨씬 더 컸다. 암논이 다말에게 말했다. "일어나서 꺼져라!"

pt.L: E Amnom a odiou [com] um ódio muito grande, porque o ódio com que a odiou [foi] maior do que o amor com que a tinha amado. E Amnom lhe disse: "Levante-se, vá!"
pt.B: Então Amnom passou a odiá-la com um ódio feroz. O que ele sentia contra ela agora era mais forte do que o amor que antes tinha sentido por ela. "Levante-se e vá embora!", Amnom disse a ela.
pt.R: Então Amnom começou a odiar Tamar com amargura. O ódio que tinha por ela era ainda mais forte do que o amor que tinha sentido antes. Ele disse a ela: "Levante-se e saia daqui!"

am.L: ከዚያም አምኖን እጅግ ታላቅ ጥላቻ ጠላት፤ የጠላባት ጥላቻ ከወደዳት ፍቅር ይበልጥ ነበረና። አምኖንም፦ «ተነሺ፤ ሂጂ» አላት።
am.B: ከዚያም አምኖን በብርቱ ጥላቻ ተነሣባት። አሁን የጠላት ጥላቻ ቀድሞ ከወደዳት ፍቅር ይበልጥ ነበረ። አምኖንም፦ «ተነሺና ሂጂ!» አላት።
am.R: ከዚያም አምኖን ትዕማርን አምርሮ ይጠላት ጀመር። ለእርሷ የነበረው ጥላቻ ቀድሞ ከነበረው ፍቅሩ እንኳ ይበልጥ ነበረ። እርሱም፦ «ተነሺና ውጪ!» አላት።

hi.L: और अम्नोन ने उससे बहुत ही बड़ी घृणा से घृणा की, क्योंकि जिस घृणा से उसने उससे घृणा की, वह उस प्रेम से बड़ी [थी] जिससे उसने उससे प्रेम किया था। और अम्नोन ने उससे कहा, "उठो, चली जाओ!"
hi.B: फिर अम्नोन उससे बहुत घृणा करने लगा। अब उसके मन में उसके लिए जो घृणा थी, वह उस प्रेम से भी बड़ी थी जो पहले उसे उससे था। "उठो और चली जाओ!" अम्नोन ने उससे कहा।
hi.R: फिर अम्नोन तामार से बहुत ही घृणा करने लगा। उसकी घृणा उसके पहले के प्रेम से भी ज़्यादा थी। उसने उससे कहा, "उठो और निकल जाओ!"

ru.L: И возненавидел её Амнон очень великой ненавистью, ведь ненависть, которой он возненавидел её, [была] больше любви, которой он полюбил её. И сказал ей Амнон: «Встань, уходи!»
ru.B: Тогда Амнон воспылал к ней лютой ненавистью. То, что он чувствовал к ней теперь, было сильнее любви, которую он прежде к ней испытывал. «Вставай и уходи!» — сказал ей Амнон.
ru.R: Тогда Амнон возненавидел Фамарь всей душой. Теперь его ненависть к ней была даже сильнее, чем была любовь. Он сказал ей: «Вставай и убирайся!»

ja.L: それからアムノンは、非常に激しい憎しみで彼女を憎んだ。彼が彼女を憎んだその憎しみは、彼が彼女を愛したその愛よりも大きかったのである。アムノンは彼女に言った。「立て、出て行け。」
ja.B: するとアムノンは、激しい憎しみを彼女に抱いた。今、彼女に抱いた憎しみは、かつて彼女に抱いた愛よりも強かった。「さっさと出て行け」とアムノンは彼女に言った。
ja.R: するとアムノンは、タマルをひどく憎み始めました。その憎しみは、前に彼女を好きだった気持ちよりも、もっと強いものでした。アムノンは彼女に言いました。「さっさと出て行け！」

uk.L: І зненавидів її Амнон дуже великою ненавистю, бо ненависть, якою він зненавидів її, [була] більша за любов, якою він любив її. І сказав їй Амнон: «Устань, іди!»
uk.B: Тоді Амнон зненавидів її лютою ненавистю. Те, що він тепер відчував до неї, було сильніше за любов, яку він колись відчував. «Устань і йди геть!» — сказав їй Амнон.
uk.R: Тоді Амнон тяжко зненавидів Тамар. Його ненависть до неї була ще сильніша, ніж колись любов. Він сказав їй: «Вставай і забирайся!»

decisions.choice: hated her with a very great hatred: the hatred is stressed
decisions.reason: The words "hate" and "hatred" come four times in the verse, "love" twice. The repetition shows how completely Amnon's desire has turned to loathing.

decisions.choice: the love with which he had loved her: his desire for her
decisions.reason: The love of verse 1 is shown to have been desire, which ended once he had used her.

decisions.choice: get up, go: a curt dismissal
decisions.reason: Two bare commands, without her name or any courtesy. He speaks to her as one would drive off someone unwanted.

decisions.choice: What he felt against her now was stronger than the love he had once felt
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable shorten the repeated "hatred with which he hated her" so the comparison reads clearly; Literal keeps the repetition. Readable says "get out" for the second command, its sense here.

decisions.choice: "घृणा ... घृणा की ... प्रेम ... प्रेम किया" (Literal)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats both roots for weight (m1); Literal keeps the repetition with "घृणा" and "प्रेम".

decisions.choice: "возненавидел её ... очень великой ненавистью" (Literal); "воспылал лютой ненавистью" (Balanced); "возненавидел всей душой" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The hatred is stressed (meaning m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew repetition of verb and noun for both the hatred and the love.

decisions.choice: L repeats "憎しみ / 憎んだ" and "愛 / 愛した" as the Hebrew does
decisions.reason: The hatred is stressed (m1).

source.text: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ אַל־אוֹדֹ֞ת הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את מֵאַחֶ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתָ עִמִּ֖י לְשַׁלְּחֵ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁמֹ֥עַֽ לָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And she said to him, no, because of this great evil, more than [the] other which you did with me, to send me away. But not he was willing to listen to her.

en.L: And she said to him, "No! For this great wrong, sending me away, [is worse] than the other that you have done to me." But he was not willing to listen to her.
en.B: "No!" she said to him. "Sending me away would be a greater wrong than what you have already done to me." But he would not listen to her.
en.R: "No!" she said. "Sending me away is even worse than what you have already done to me." But he would not listen to her.

es.L: Y ella le dijo: «¡No! Porque este gran mal, echarme, [es peor] que el otro que me has hecho». Pero él no quiso escucharla.
es.B: «¡No!», le dijo ella. «Echarme ahora sería un mal mayor que el que ya me has hecho». Pero él no quiso escucharla.
es.R: «¡No!», le dijo ella. «Echarme ahora es todavía peor que lo que ya me has hecho». Pero él no quiso escucharla.

fr.L: Et elle lui dit : « Non ! Car ce grand mal, me renvoyer, [est pire] que l’autre que tu m’as fait. » Mais il ne voulut pas l’écouter.
fr.B: « Non ! lui dit-elle. Me renvoyer serait un mal plus grand encore que celui que tu viens de me faire. » Mais il ne voulut pas l’écouter.
fr.R: « Non ! a-t-elle dit. Me chasser maintenant, c’est encore pire que ce que tu m’as déjà fait. » Mais il n’a pas voulu l’écouter.

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Hapana! Kwa maana uovu huu mkubwa, wa kunifukuza, [ni mbaya zaidi] kuliko ule mwingine ulionitendea." Lakini hakutaka kumsikiliza.
sw.B: Akamwambia, "Hapana! Kunifukuza kungekuwa uovu mkubwa zaidi kuliko ule ulionitendea tayari." Lakini hakutaka kumsikiliza.
sw.R: Akasema, "Hapana! Kunifukuza ni vibaya kuliko hata ulichonitendea tayari." Lakini hakutaka kumsikiliza.

vi.L: Nàng nói với chàng: "Không! Vì điều sai trái lớn này, là đuổi em đi, [còn tệ hơn] điều kia anh đã làm với em." Nhưng chàng không muốn nghe nàng.
vi.B: Nàng nói: "Không! Đuổi em đi lúc này còn là tội lớn hơn điều anh vừa làm với em." Nhưng chàng không chịu nghe nàng.
vi.R: Nàng nói: "Không! Đuổi em đi còn tệ hơn điều anh vừa làm với em." Nhưng chàng không chịu nghe nàng.

ko.L: 그러자 그 여자가 그에게 말했다. "안 돼요! 나를 쫓아내는 이 큰 악은 오라버니가 나에게 한 다른 일보다 [더 나빠요]." 그러나 그는 그 여자의 말을 들으려 하지 않았다.
ko.B: 다말이 그에게 말했다. "안 돼요! 나를 이렇게 쫓아내는 것은 오라버니가 이미 나에게 한 일보다 더 큰 잘못이에요." 그러나 암논은 다말의 말을 들으려 하지 않았다.
ko.R: 다말이 말했다. "안 돼요! 나를 쫓아내는 것은 오라버니가 이미 나에게 한 짓보다 더 나빠요." 그러나 암논은 다말의 말을 듣지 않았다.

pt.L: E ela lhe disse: "Não! Porque este grande mal, mandar-me embora, [é pior] do que o outro que você me fez." Mas ele não quis ouvi-la.
pt.B: "Não!", ela lhe disse. "Mandar-me embora seria um mal maior do que o que você já me fez." Mas ele não quis ouvi-la.
pt.R: "Não!", disse ela. "Se você me mandar embora, isso vai ser ainda pior do que o que você já me fez." Mas ele não quis ouvir Tamar.

am.L: እርሷም፦ «አይሆንም! እኔን መስደድህ ይህ ታላቅ ክፋት በእኔ ላይ ካደረግኸው ከሌላው [የከፋ ነው]» አለችው። እርሱ ግን ሊሰማት አልወደደም።
am.B: እርሷም፦ «አይሆንም!» አለችው። «እኔን ማባረርህ አስቀድመህ ካደረግህብኝ የባሰ በደል ነው።» እርሱ ግን ሊሰማት አልፈለገም።
am.R: እርሷም፦ «አይሆንም!» አለች። «እኔን ማባረርህ አስቀድመህ ካደረግህብኝ እንኳ የከፋ ነው።» እርሱ ግን ሊሰማት አልፈለገም።

hi.L: और उसने उससे कहा, "नहीं! क्योंकि मुझे भेज देने की यह बड़ी बुराई उस दूसरी से [बढ़कर है] जो तुमने मेरे साथ की है।" पर उसने उसकी बात सुनना न चाहा।
hi.B: "नहीं!" उसने उससे कहा। "मुझे इस तरह भेज देना उस बुराई से भी बड़ी बुराई होगी जो तुम मेरे साथ कर चुके हो।" पर उसने उसकी एक न सुनी।
hi.R: "नहीं!" उसने कहा। "मुझे इस तरह भगा देना उससे भी बुरा है जो तुम मेरे साथ कर चुके हो।" पर उसने उसकी नहीं सुनी।

ru.L: И сказала она ему: «Нет! Ведь это великое зло — выгнать меня — [хуже] того другого, что ты сделал со мной.» Но он не захотел слушать её.
ru.B: «Нет!» — сказала она ему. — «Выгнать меня — это ещё большее зло, чем то, что ты уже сделал со мной.» Но он не стал её слушать.
ru.R: «Нет!» — сказала она. — «Выгнать меня — это ещё хуже, чем то, что ты уже сделал со мной.» Но он не стал её слушать.

ja.L: 彼女は彼に言った。「いいえ、わたしを追い出すというこの大きな悪は、あなたがわたしにしたもう一つ[の悪]よりも[ひどいことです]。」しかし彼は彼女に聞き従おうとしなかった。
ja.B: 「いけません」と彼女は言った。「わたしを追い出すことは、あなたが今わたしにしたことよりも、もっと大きな悪です。」しかし彼は彼女の言うことを聞こうとしなかった。
ja.R: 「やめてください！」と彼女は言いました。「わたしを追い出すのは、さっきあなたがしたことよりも、もっとひどいことです。」しかしアムノンは、彼女の言うことを聞こうとしませんでした。

uk.L: І сказала вона йому: «Ні! Бо це велике зло — вигнати мене — [гірше] за те інше, що ти зробив мені.» Але він не хотів слухати її.
uk.B: «Ні!» — сказала вона йому. — «Вигнати мене — це ще більше зло, ніж те, що ти вже зробив мені.» Але він не хотів її слухати.
uk.R: «Ні!» — сказала вона. — «Вигнати мене — ще гірше, ніж те, що ти вже зробив мені.» Але він не хотів її слухати.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew text, read as: "No, for this great wrong of sending me away is worse than the other you did to me"
alternatives: No, brother, for this last wrong is greater than the first (ancient Greek)
decisions.reason: Tamar's words are hard to read in the Hebrew, as if spoken in distress, and the first words ("no, because of") do not fit together easily. The sense is clear enough: to send her away would be a greater wrong than the rape itself. The ancient Greek translation reads roughly "No, brother, for this last wrong is greater than the first", which may reflect a slightly different Hebrew text. The Hebrew is followed here; reviewers should check the Greek wording against an edition.

decisions.choice: to send me away: what the law forbade such a man to do
decisions.reason: The law said that a man who seized and lay with an unmarried girl must marry her and "may not send her away all his days" (Deuteronomy 22:29; see also Exodus 22:15). Amnon does the very thing the law forbade, and leaves her disgraced and without a husband. The verb returns in verse 17.

decisions.choice: he was not willing to listen to her: as in verse 14
decisions.reason: The narrator repeats the words of verse 14. A second time, her plea goes unheard.

decisions.choice: Sending me away would be a greater wrong
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the sending away at the front so the comparison is clear. Literal follows the Hebrew order and brackets "is worse", which the Hebrew leaves to be understood.

decisions.choice: "भेज देना" (Literal, Balanced); "भगा देना" (Readable)
decisions.reason: To send her away is what the law forbade such a man to do (m2); the same verb as Amnon's order in verse 17 at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: one quotation broken by "— сказала она ему. —"
decisions.reason: As in verse 12, two pairs of marks where the English counts two quotations.

decisions.choice: shalach "追い出す" at every level
decisions.reason: To send her away (m2); the same verb in 13:17 ("出す").

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶֽת־נַעֲרוֹ֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁלְחוּ־נָ֥א אֶת־זֹ֛את מֵעָלַ֖י הַח֑וּצָה וּנְעֹ֥ל הַדֶּ֖לֶת אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he called his young man, his attendant, and said, send away please this from with me outside, and bolt the door after her.

en.L: And he called his young man who served him and said, "Please send this [woman] away from me, outside, and bolt the door after her."
en.B: He called the young man who attended him and said, "Put this woman out of my room, and bolt the door behind her."
en.R: He called his personal servant and said, "Get this woman out of here! Lock the door behind her!"

es.L: Y llamó a su joven que le servía y le dijo: «Te ruego que eches a esta [mujer] de mi lado, afuera, y cierra la puerta tras ella con cerrojo».
es.B: Llamó al joven que lo atendía y le dijo: «Saca a esta mujer de mi cuarto y echa el cerrojo a la puerta detrás de ella».
es.R: Llamó a su criado personal y le dijo: «¡Saca de aquí a esta mujer! ¡Cierra la puerta con llave detrás de ella!».

fr.L: Et il appela le jeune homme qui le servait et dit : « Renvoie donc celle-ci loin de moi, dehors, et verrouille la porte derrière elle. »
fr.B: Il appela le jeune homme qui était à son service et lui dit : « Mets cette femme hors de chez moi, et verrouille la porte derrière elle. »
fr.R: Il a appelé son serviteur personnel et lui a dit : « Fais sortir cette femme d’ici ! Ferme la porte à clé derrière elle ! »

sw.L: Akamwita kijana wake aliyemhudumia, akasema, "Tafadhali mtoe huyu kutoka kwangu, nje, ufunge mlango kwa komeo nyuma yake."
sw.B: Akamwita kijana aliyemtumikia, akasema, "Mtoe mwanamke huyu chumbani mwangu, ufunge mlango kwa komeo nyuma yake."
sw.R: Akamwita mtumishi wake wa karibu, akasema, "Mtoe mwanamke huyu hapa! Funga mlango nyuma yake!"

vi.L: Chàng gọi người đầy tớ trẻ phục vụ mình mà nói: "Hãy đuổi [người đàn bà] này ra khỏi chỗ ta, ra bên ngoài, rồi cài then cửa sau lưng nó."
vi.B: Chàng gọi người đầy tớ trẻ hầu cận mình và nói: "Đuổi người đàn bà này ra khỏi phòng ta, rồi cài then cửa sau lưng nó."
vi.R: Chàng gọi người đầy tớ riêng của mình và nói: "Đuổi người đàn bà này ra khỏi đây! Khóa cửa lại sau lưng nó!"

ko.L: 그리고 그는 자기를 시중드는 젊은 종을 불러 말했다. "부디 이 [여자]를 내게서 밖으로 내보내고, 그 여자 뒤로 문을 잠가라."
ko.B: 암논은 자기 시중을 드는 젊은 종을 불러 말했다. "이 여자를 내 방에서 내보내고, 뒤에서 문을 잠가라."
ko.R: 암논은 자기 몸종을 불러 말했다. "이 여자를 여기서 끌어내라! 그리고 문을 잠가라!"

pt.L: E ele chamou o seu jovem que o servia e disse: "Por favor, ponha esta [mulher] para fora, de junto de mim, e passe a tranca na porta atrás dela."
pt.B: Ele chamou o jovem que o servia e disse: "Ponha esta mulher para fora do meu quarto e tranque a porta atrás dela."
pt.R: Ele chamou o seu criado pessoal e disse: "Tire esta mulher daqui! Tranque a porta depois que ela sair!"

am.L: የሚያገለግለውንም ብላቴናውን ጠርቶ፦ «እባክህ ይህችን ከእኔ ዘንድ ወደ ውጭ አስወጣት፤ ከኋላዋም በሩን ቀርቅረው» አለው።
am.B: የሚያገለግለውን ብላቴና ጠርቶ፦ «ይህችን ሴት ከክፍሌ አስወጣት፤ ከኋላዋም በሩን ቀርቅረው» አለው።
am.R: የግል አገልጋዩን ጠርቶ፦ «ይህችን ሴት ከዚህ አስወጣት! በሩንም ከኋላዋ ቆልፈው!» አለው።

hi.L: और उसने अपने सेवक जवान को बुलाकर कहा, "कृपया इसे मेरे पास से बाहर भेज दो, और इसके पीछे द्वार की चिटकनी लगा दो।"
hi.B: उसने अपनी सेवा करनेवाले जवान को बुलाकर कहा, "इस स्त्री को मेरे कमरे से बाहर कर दो, और इसके पीछे द्वार की चिटकनी लगा दो।"
hi.R: उसने अपने निजी सेवक को बुलाकर कहा, "इस औरत को यहाँ से बाहर निकालो! इसके पीछे दरवाज़ा बंद कर दो!"

ru.L: И позвал он своего юношу, который прислуживал ему, и сказал: «Выгони, прошу, эту от меня вон и запри за ней дверь.»
ru.B: Он позвал юношу, который ему прислуживал, и сказал: «Выставь эту женщину из моей комнаты и запри за ней дверь на засов.»
ru.R: Он позвал своего личного слугу и сказал: «Убери отсюда эту женщину! Запри за ней дверь!»

ja.L: 彼は自分に仕える若者を呼んで言った。「どうか、この[女]をわたしのところから外へ追い出して、その後ろで戸にかんぬきを掛けよ。」
ja.B: 彼は自分に仕えている若者を呼んで言った。「この女をわたしの部屋から追い出し、後ろの戸にかんぬきを掛けろ。」
ja.R: アムノンは身の回りの世話をする召し使いを呼んで、言いました。「この女をここから追い出せ！そして、戸にかぎを掛けろ！」

uk.L: І покликав він свого юнака, що прислуговував йому, і сказав: «Вижени, прошу, цю [жінку] від мене геть і замкни за нею двері.»
uk.B: Він покликав юнака, що прислуговував йому, і сказав: «Вижени цю жінку з моєї кімнати й замкни за нею двері на засув.»
uk.R: Він покликав свого особистого слугу й сказав: «Забери звідси цю жінку! Замкни за нею двері!»

decisions.choice: this: a word of contempt
decisions.reason: Amnon does not name her or call her his sister; he says only "this" (a feminine form, "this one"). The bare word shows his scorn.

decisions.choice: his young man who served him: his personal attendant
decisions.reason: The two words name a young man in his personal service. He is the only witness of how Tamar was thrown out.

decisions.choice: send away: the verb of verse 16
decisions.reason: Amnon gives the very order Tamar has just begged him not to give, and has his servant carry it out.

decisions.choice: Put this woman out of my room (Balanced); Get this woman out of here (Readable)
decisions.reason: The "please" in Amnon's order is a matter of form, and Balanced and Readable leave it out. "Woman" is supplied at every level for the bare "this", which English cannot use alone; Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: "celle-ci"
decisions.reason: French has a feminine demonstrative pronoun that says "this one" with the same coldness as the Hebrew (m1), so Literal needs no bracketed noun.

decisions.choice: "nó" for Tamar in Amnon's mouth
decisions.reason: Amnon no longer names her or calls her sister; he says only "this" (meaning decision). The narrator keeps "nàng" for her; Amnon's "nó" carries his contempt.

decisions.choice: "इसे" (Literal); "इस स्त्री को" (Balanced); "इस औरत को" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "This" is a word of contempt (m1); Literal keeps the bare pronoun, Readable the cold everyday word.

decisions.choice: "эту" (Literal); "эту женщину" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "This" is a word of contempt (meaning m1); Literal keeps the bare pronoun, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "юношу, который прислуживал ему" (Literal, Balanced); "личного слугу" (Readable)
decisions.reason: His personal attendant (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: zot "この[女]" (L), "この女" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A word of contempt (m1); Japanese この女 carries it.

decisions.choice: na'aro mesharto "自分に仕える若者" (L, B), "身の回りの世話をする召し使い" (R)
decisions.reason: His personal attendant (m2).

source.text: וְעָלֶ֨יהָ֙ כְּתֹ֣נֶת פַּסִּ֔ים כִּי֩ כֵ֨ן תִּלְבַּ֧שְׁןָ בְנוֹת־הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ הַבְּתוּלֹ֖ת מְעִילִ֑ים וַיֹּצֵ֨א אוֹתָ֤הּ מְשָֽׁרְתוֹ֙ הַח֔וּץ וְנָעַ֥ל הַדֶּ֖לֶת אַחֲרֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And on her [was] a tunic of passim, for thus were clothed [the] daughters of the king, the virgins, [in] robes; and brought her out his attendant outside and bolted the door after her.

en.L: Now she had on her a tunic [reaching to the] wrists [and ankles], for the virgin daughters of the king were clothed [in] such robes. And his attendant brought her outside and bolted the door after her.
en.B: She was wearing a long-sleeved robe, the kind of robe the king's unmarried daughters wore. His servant put her out and bolted the door behind her.
en.R: Tamar was wearing a special robe with long sleeves. The king's daughters who were not yet married wore robes like that. Amnon's servant put her outside and locked the door behind her.

es.L: Y ella llevaba puesta una túnica [que llegaba hasta las] muñecas [y los tobillos], porque las hijas vírgenes del rey se vestían [con] tales mantos. Y su servidor la sacó afuera y cerró la puerta tras ella con cerrojo.
es.B: Ella llevaba una túnica de mangas largas, como las que vestían las hijas solteras del rey. El criado la sacó afuera y echó el cerrojo a la puerta detrás de ella.
es.R: Tamar llevaba puesta una túnica especial de mangas largas. Las hijas del rey que todavía no se habían casado vestían túnicas así. El criado de Amnón la sacó afuera y cerró la puerta con llave detrás de ella.

fr.L: Or elle avait sur elle une tunique [descendant jusqu’aux] poignets [et aux chevilles], car les filles du roi, les vierges, étaient vêtues de telles robes. Et son serviteur la mit dehors et verrouilla la porte derrière elle.
fr.B: Elle portait une longue robe à manches, la robe que portaient les filles du roi qui n’étaient pas mariées. Le serviteur la mit dehors et verrouilla la porte derrière elle.
fr.R: Tamar portait une robe spéciale à longues manches. Les filles du roi qui n’étaient pas encore mariées portaient des robes comme celle-là. Le serviteur d’Amnon l’a mise dehors et a fermé la porte à clé derrière elle.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa amevaa kanzu [ndefu hadi] viganjani [na miguuni], kwa maana binti za mfalme walio mabikira walivaa mavazi [kama] hayo. Mhudumu wake akamtoa nje, akafunga mlango kwa komeo nyuma yake.
sw.B: Alikuwa amevaa joho refu lenye mikono mirefu, aina ya joho walilovaa binti za mfalme ambao hawakuwa wameolewa. Mtumishi wake akamtoa nje, akafunga mlango kwa komeo nyuma yake.
sw.R: Tamari alikuwa amevaa joho maalumu lenye mikono mirefu. Binti za mfalme ambao bado hawajaolewa walivaa majoho kama hayo. Mtumishi wa Amnoni akamweka nje, akafunga mlango nyuma yake.

vi.L: Nàng mặc một chiếc áo dài [đến] cổ tay [và cổ chân], vì các công chúa còn trinh nữ đều mặc áo choàng như thế. Người hầu của chàng đưa nàng ra ngoài và cài then cửa sau lưng nàng.
vi.B: Nàng đang mặc một chiếc áo dài tay, là loại áo mà các công chúa chưa lấy chồng thường mặc. Người hầu của Am-nôn đưa nàng ra ngoài và cài then cửa lại sau lưng nàng.
vi.R: Ta-ma đang mặc một chiếc áo đặc biệt có tay dài. Các con gái của vua chưa lấy chồng đều mặc áo như thế. Người đầy tớ của Am-nôn đưa nàng ra ngoài và khóa cửa lại sau lưng nàng.

ko.L: 그 여자는 [손목과 발목까지 내려오는] 긴 옷을 입고 있었는데, 왕의 처녀 딸들은 그런 겉옷을 입었기 때문이다. 그의 시종이 그 여자를 밖으로 데리고 나가서 그 여자 뒤로 문을 잠갔다.
ko.B: 다말은 소매가 긴 옷을 입고 있었는데, 그것은 왕의 시집가지 않은 딸들이 입는 옷이었다. 암논의 종이 다말을 밖으로 내보내고 뒤에서 문을 잠갔다.
ko.R: 다말은 소매가 긴 특별한 옷을 입고 있었다. 왕의 딸들 가운데 아직 결혼하지 않은 딸들이 그런 옷을 입었다. 암논의 종은 다말을 밖으로 내보내고 문을 잠갔다.

pt.L: E ela [tinha] sobre si uma túnica [que chegava aos] pulsos [e aos tornozelos], porque assim se vestiam as filhas virgens do rei, [com] mantos. E o servo dele a levou para fora e passou a tranca na porta atrás dela.
pt.B: Ela estava usando uma túnica longa, de mangas compridas, o tipo de manto que as filhas solteiras do rei usavam. O servo a pôs para fora e trancou a porta atrás dela.
pt.R: Tamar estava usando uma túnica especial, de mangas compridas. As filhas do rei que ainda não tinham se casado usavam roupas assim. O servo de Amnom a pôs para fora e trancou a porta atrás dela.

am.L: በላይዋም እስከ እጅ አንጓና እስከ ቁርጭምጭሚት [የሚደርስ] ቀሚስ ነበረ፤ ደናግል የሆኑት የንጉሡ ሴቶች ልጆች እንዲህ ያሉ ልብሶችን ይለብሱ ነበርና። አገልጋዩም ወደ ውጭ አወጣት፤ ከኋላዋም በሩን ቀረቀረ።
am.B: እርሷም ረጅም እጅጌ ያለው ቀሚስ ለብሳ ነበረ፤ ያላገቡት የንጉሡ ሴቶች ልጆች እንዲህ ያለውን ቀሚስ ይለብሱ ነበርና። አገልጋዩም አውጥቶ ከኋላዋ በሩን ቀረቀረ።
am.R: ትዕማር ረጅም እጅጌ ያለው ልዩ ቀሚስ ለብሳ ነበረ። ያላገቡት የንጉሡ ሴቶች ልጆች እንዲህ ያለውን ቀሚስ ይለብሱ ነበር። የአምኖንም አገልጋይ ወደ ውጭ አውጥቶ ከኋላዋ በሩን ቆለፈ።

hi.L: और वह कलाइयों [और टखनों] तक का एक कुरता पहने हुए थी, क्योंकि राजा की कुँवारी बेटियाँ ऐसे ही वस्त्र पहनती थीं। और उसके सेवक ने उसे बाहर निकाल दिया और उसके पीछे द्वार की चिटकनी लगा दी।
hi.B: वह लंबी बाँहोंवाला चोग़ा पहने हुए थी, उस तरह का वस्त्र जो राजा की अविवाहित बेटियाँ पहनती थीं। उसके सेवक ने उसे बाहर कर दिया और उसके पीछे द्वार की चिटकनी लगा दी।
hi.R: तामार लंबी बाँहोंवाला एक ख़ास चोग़ा पहने हुए थी। राजा की जो बेटियाँ अभी अविवाहित थीं, वे ऐसे ही चोग़े पहनती थीं। अम्नोन के सेवक ने उसे बाहर निकाल दिया और उसके पीछे दरवाज़ा बंद कर दिया।

ru.L: А на ней [был] хитон [длиной до] запястий [и лодыжек], ведь в такие одежды одевались дочери царя, девственницы. И вывел её его слуга вон, и запер за ней дверь.
ru.B: На ней была длинная одежда с рукавами — такую носили незамужние царские дочери. Слуга выставил её вон и запер за ней дверь на засов.
ru.R: На Фамари была особая одежда с длинными рукавами. Такую одежду носили царские дочери, которые ещё не вышли замуж. Слуга Амнона вывел её наружу и запер за ней дверь.

ja.L: 彼女は、手首と足首まで[届く]長衣を着ていた。王の娘たちで処女である者は、このような衣を着ていたからである。彼に仕える者は彼女を外に連れ出し、その後ろで戸にかんぬきを掛けた。
ja.B: 彼女は袖の長い衣を着ていた。王の未婚の娘たちは、そのような衣を着ていたのである。アムノンの召し使いは彼女を外に追い出し、後ろの戸にかんぬきを掛けた。
ja.R: タマルは、長いそでの付いた特別な衣を着ていました。王の娘たちで、まだ結婚していない者は、そのような衣を着ていたのです。アムノンの召し使いは、タマルを外に追い出し、戸にかぎを掛けました。

uk.L: А на ній була туніка [до] запʼясть [і до кісточок], бо в такі шати вдягалися царські дочки-діви. І вивів її його слуга надвір, і замкнув за нею двері.
uk.B: На ній була сукня з довгими рукавами, яку носили незаміжні царські дочки. Його слуга вивів її надвір і замкнув за нею двері на засув.
uk.R: На Тамар була особлива сукня з довгими рукавами. Такі сукні носили царські дочки, які ще не вийшли заміж. Амнонів слуга виставив її надвір і замкнув за нею двері.

decisions.choice: a tunic of passim: a long robe reaching to the wrists and ankles
decisions.reason: Passim probably means "palms (of the hands) and soles (of the feet)": a full-length robe with long sleeves, as worn by those who did no hard work. It is the same garment Jacob gave Joseph (Genesis 37:3), the only other place it is named. The ancient Greek translation took it to mean a robe reaching the wrists here and "many-colored" in Genesis; the length and sleeves, not the color, seem to be the point.

decisions.choice: the virgin daughters of the king: the robe marked her rank and her state
decisions.reason: The robe showed that she was a king's daughter and unmarried. The narrator pauses to describe it just as she is thrown out, so that the reader sees what has been taken from her; in verse 19 she tears it.

decisions.choice: robes: the outer garments
decisions.reason: The word names a robe or mantle worn over other clothes (1 Samuel 18:4; 24:5). Its place at the end of the clause is awkward in Hebrew, and some suggest it is a slightly changed form of "from long ago" ("so the king's daughters had dressed from of old"). The sense of the verse is not affected.

decisions.choice: a tunic [reaching to the] wrists [and ankles] (Literal); a long-sleeved robe (Balanced); a special robe with long sleeves (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same wording as for Joseph's robe in Genesis 37:3, so that readers can see the link. The familiar "coat of many colors" follows the Greek translation of Genesis.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: The word for the attendant of verse 17 is "one who serves"; Balanced and Readable say "servant". Readable names him as Amnon's servant, since "his" could seem to point to someone else.

decisions.choice: una túnica [que llegaba hasta las] muñecas [y los tobillos] (L); una túnica de mangas largas (B); una túnica especial de mangas largas (R)
decisions.reason: As the English decision (r-en-1), the robe is one reaching to the wrists and ankles, the mark of a king's unmarried daughter; Literal shows the supplied words in brackets.

decisions.choice: su servidor (L); el criado (B, R)
decisions.reason: For this block: the young men and attendants who serve a master (naʿar, meshareth) are 'criados' at Balanced and Readable, and 'jóvenes' or 'servidor' at Literal; 'siervos' is kept for ʿeved, the king's servants, so that the two words stay apart.

decisions.choice: kanzu [ndefu hadi] viganjani [na miguuni] (L); joho refu lenye mikono mirefu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The robe is a long garment reaching wrists and ankles (meaning decision m1), not a coloured one. Literal brackets the explanation as the English does; Balanced and Readable say "joho" with long sleeves, the robe of a king's unmarried daughter.

decisions.choice: "áo dài [đến] cổ tay [và cổ chân]" (L); "áo dài tay" (B); "áo đặc biệt có tay dài" (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as Joseph's robe in the Vietnamese Genesis 37:3 should be checked by a reviewer so readers see the link; "áo nhiều màu" follows an old guess the meaning decision sets aside.

decisions.choice: "[손목과 발목까지 내려오는] 긴 옷" (L); "소매가 긴 옷" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: the *passim* robe reached the wrists and ankles. "채색옷" (a many-coloured robe) follows the old Greek and Latin reading of the word and is not used.

decisions.choice: uma túnica [que chegava aos] pulsos [e aos tornozelos] (L); uma túnica longa, de mangas compridas (B); uma túnica especial, de mangas compridas (R); mantos
decisions.reason: It is the garment Jacob gave Joseph (m1), so each level keeps the wording of Genesis 37:3 in Portuguese, where the English does the same, also in verse 19. The outer robes (m3) are "mantos", the book-wide word of 1 Samuel 2:19 and 24:5 in Portuguese; Readable says "roupas".

decisions.choice: the ketonet passim is worded as Joseph's robe in Genesis 37: "እስከ እጅ አንጓና እስከ ቁርጭምጭሚት [የሚደርስ] ቀሚስ" (Literal), "ረጅም እጅጌ ያለው ቀሚስ" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew phrase is the same as Genesis 37:3, so the Amharic keeps the wording used there.

decisions.choice: "कलाइयों [और टखनों] तक का कुरता" (Literal); "लंबी बाँहोंवाला चोग़ा" (Balanced); "लंबी बाँहोंवाला एक ख़ास चोग़ा" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same garment as Joseph's (Genesis 37:3), worded as that verse in this translation at each level (m1).

decisions.choice: "хитон [длиной до] запястий [и лодыжек]" (Literal); "длинная одежда с рукавами" (Balanced); "особая одежда с длинными рукавами" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The same garment as Joseph's (Genesis 37:3, meaning m1); Russian uses the wording of Genesis 37:3 in this translation at each level, here and in verse 19.

decisions.choice: "девственницы" (Literal); "незамужние" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The robe marked her rank and her state (meaning m2); Balanced and Readable say unmarried, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ketonet passim "手首と足首まで[届く]長衣" (L), "袖の長い衣" (B), "長いそでの付いた特別な衣" (R)
decisions.reason: A long robe reaching to the wrists and ankles (m1, uncertain), as the English levels.

source.text: וַתִּקַּ֨ח תָּמָ֥ר אֵ֨פֶר֙ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וּכְתֹ֧נֶת הַפַּסִּ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלֶ֖יהָ קָרָ֑עָה וַתָּ֤שֶׂם יָדָהּ֙ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֖וֹךְ וְזָעָֽקָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Tamar ashes on her head, and the tunic of passim which [was] on her she tore, and put her hand on her head and went, going and crying out.

en.L: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and she tore the tunic [reaching to the] wrists [and ankles] that [was] on her, and she put her hand on her head and went away, crying out as she went.
en.B: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the long-sleeved robe she was wearing. She put her hand on her head and went away, crying aloud as she went.
en.R: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore her special robe with long sleeves. She put her hand on her head to show her grief. Then she went away, crying loudly.

es.L: Y Tamar se echó ceniza sobre la cabeza, y rasgó la túnica [que llegaba hasta las] muñecas [y los tobillos] que [llevaba] puesta, y se puso la mano sobre la cabeza y se fue, gritando mientras andaba.
es.B: Tamar se echó ceniza en la cabeza y rasgó la túnica de mangas largas que llevaba. Se puso la mano sobre la cabeza y se fue, gritando en voz alta mientras caminaba.
es.R: Tamar se echó ceniza en la cabeza y rasgó su túnica especial de mangas largas. Se puso la mano sobre la cabeza para mostrar su dolor. Luego se fue llorando a gritos.

fr.L: Et Tamar mit de la cendre sur sa tête, et la tunique [descendant jusqu’aux] poignets [et aux chevilles] qu’elle avait sur elle, elle la déchira ; et elle mit sa main sur sa tête et s’en alla, poussant des cris en marchant.
fr.B: Tamar répandit de la cendre sur sa tête et déchira la longue robe à manches qu’elle portait. Elle mit la main sur sa tête et s’en alla en criant tout le long du chemin.
fr.R: Tamar a mis de la cendre sur sa tête et a déchiré sa robe spéciale à longues manches. Elle a posé la main sur sa tête pour montrer sa douleur. Puis elle est partie en pleurant très fort.

sw.L: Tamari akatia majivu kichwani pake, na ile kanzu [ndefu hadi] viganjani [na miguuni] aliyokuwa ameivaa akairarua, akaweka mkono wake kichwani pake, akaenda zake, akilia kwa sauti alipokuwa akienda.
sw.B: Tamari akajitia majivu kichwani, akalirarua lile joho refu lenye mikono mirefu alilokuwa amevaa. Akaweka mkono wake kichwani, akaenda zake akilia kwa sauti kuu.
sw.R: Tamari akajitia majivu kichwani, akalirarua joho lake maalumu lenye mikono mirefu. Akaweka mkono wake kichwani kuonyesha huzuni yake. Kisha akaenda zake akilia kwa sauti.

vi.L: Ta-ma lấy tro rắc lên đầu mình, xé chiếc áo dài [đến] cổ tay [và cổ chân] nàng đang mặc, đặt tay lên đầu và đi, vừa đi vừa kêu khóc.
vi.B: Ta-ma rắc tro lên đầu và xé chiếc áo dài tay mình đang mặc. Nàng đặt tay lên đầu rồi bỏ đi, vừa đi vừa khóc lớn.
vi.R: Ta-ma rắc tro lên đầu và xé chiếc áo đặc biệt có tay dài của mình. Nàng đặt tay lên đầu để tỏ nỗi đau buồn. Rồi nàng bỏ đi, khóc lớn.

ko.L: 다말은 머리에 재를 뒤집어쓰고, 입고 있던 [손목과 발목까지 내려오는] 긴 옷을 찢고, 손을 머리에 얹고 걸어가면서 울부짖었다.
ko.B: 다말은 머리에 재를 뒤집어쓰고 입고 있던 긴 소매 옷을 찢었다. 그리고 손을 머리에 얹고 소리 내어 울며 걸어갔다.
ko.R: 다말은 머리에 재를 뒤집어쓰고, 입고 있던 소매가 긴 특별한 옷을 찢었다. 그리고 슬픔을 나타내려고 손을 머리에 얹었다. 그러고는 큰 소리로 울면서 떠나갔다.

pt.L: E Tamar pôs cinza sobre a cabeça, e rasgou a túnica [que chegava aos] pulsos [e aos tornozelos] que [estava] sobre ela, e pôs a mão sobre a cabeça, e foi embora, andando e gritando.
pt.B: Tamar pôs cinza na cabeça e rasgou a túnica longa, de mangas compridas, que estava usando. Pôs a mão na cabeça e foi embora, gritando alto enquanto andava.
pt.R: Tamar pôs cinza na cabeça e rasgou a sua túnica especial de mangas compridas. Pôs a mão na cabeça para mostrar a sua dor. Depois foi embora, chorando alto.

am.L: ትዕማርም በራሷ ላይ አመድ ነሰነሰች፤ የለበሰችውንም እስከ እጅ አንጓና እስከ ቁርጭምጭሚት [የሚደርሰውን] ቀሚስ ቀደደች፤ እጇንም በራሷ ላይ አድርጋ እየጮኸች ሄደች።
am.B: ትዕማር በራሷ ላይ አመድ ነሰነሰች፤ የለበሰችውንም ረጅም እጅጌ ያለውን ቀሚስ ቀደደች። እጇንም በራሷ ላይ አድርጋ ድምፅዋን ከፍ አድርጋ እያለቀሰች ሄደች።
am.R: ትዕማር በራሷ ላይ አመድ ነሰነሰች፤ ረጅም እጅጌ ያለውን ልዩ ቀሚሷንም ቀደደች። ሐዘኗን ለማሳየት እጇን በራሷ ላይ አደረገች። ከዚያም ጮክ ብላ እያለቀሰች ሄደች።

hi.L: और तामार ने अपने सिर पर राख डाली, और कलाइयों [और टखनों] तक का जो कुरता वह पहने थी उसे फाड़ डाला, और सिर पर हाथ रखकर चिल्लाती हुई चली गई।
hi.B: तामार ने अपने सिर पर राख डाली और जो लंबी बाँहोंवाला चोग़ा वह पहने थी, उसे फाड़ डाला। फिर सिर पर हाथ रखकर वह ऊँचे स्वर से रोती हुई चली गई।
hi.R: तामार ने अपने सिर पर राख डाली और अपना लंबी बाँहोंवाला ख़ास चोग़ा फाड़ डाला। उसने अपना दुख दिखाने के लिए अपने सिर पर हाथ रखा। फिर वह ज़ोर-ज़ोर से रोती हुई चली गई।

ru.L: И взяла Фамарь пепел на свою голову, и хитон [длиной до] запястий [и лодыжек], который [был] на ней, разорвала, и положила свою руку на свою голову, и пошла, идя и крича.
ru.B: Фамарь посыпала голову пеплом и разорвала длинную одежду с рукавами, которая была на ней. Она положила руку на голову и пошла прочь, громко плача на ходу.
ru.R: Фамарь посыпала голову пеплом и разорвала свою особую одежду с длинными рукавами. Она положила руку на голову в знак горя. Потом она пошла прочь, громко плача.

ja.L: タマルは頭に灰をかぶり、身に着けていた手首と足首まで[届く]長衣を裂き、手を頭に置いて、叫びながら去って行った。
ja.B: タマルは頭に灰をかぶり、着ていた袖の長い衣を裂いた。そして手を頭に置き、声を上げて泣きながら去って行った。
ja.R: タマルは頭に灰をかぶり、長いそでの付いた特別な衣を引き裂きました。悲しみを表すために手を頭に置いて、大声で泣きながら去って行きました。

uk.L: І посипала Тамар попіл на свою голову, і роздерла туніку [до] запʼясть [і до кісточок], що [була] на ній, і поклала свою руку на свою голову, і йшла, голосно кричачи.
uk.B: Тамар посипала голову попелом і роздерла сукню з довгими рукавами, яка була на ній. Вона поклала руку на голову й пішла, голосно плачучи дорогою.
uk.R: Тамар посипала голову попелом і роздерла свою особливу сукню з довгими рукавами. Вона поклала руку на голову на знак горя. Потім вона пішла геть, голосно плачучи.

decisions.choice: ashes on her head; tore the robe: signs of mourning
decisions.reason: Putting dust or ashes on the head and tearing clothes were the usual signs of grief and disaster (1:2; Joshua 7:6). Tearing the robe that marked her as a king's virgin daughter shows what she has lost.

decisions.choice: put her hand on her head: a gesture of grief and shame
decisions.reason: The same gesture is named in Jeremiah 2:37, of people led away in disgrace.

decisions.choice: went, going and crying out: she cried out as she went, openly
decisions.reason: The verb "go" is doubled, describing an action that went on: she kept crying out as she walked. In the law, a woman's cry for help is what shows that she was forced (Deuteronomy 22:24, 27). Tamar does not hide what has happened.

decisions.choice: to show her grief
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the gesture meant.

decisions.choice: "пошла, идя и крича" (Literal); "громко плача на ходу" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew doubling of the verb; she cried out as she went, openly (meaning m3).

decisions.choice: "灰をかぶり…衣を裂き…手を頭に置いて" at every level; R adds "悲しみを表すために"
decisions.reason: Signs of mourning and shame (m1, m2), as the English Readable.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֜יהָ אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם אָחִ֗יהָ הַאֲמִינ֣וֹן אָחִיךְ֮ הָיָ֣ה עִמָּךְ֒ וְעַתָּ֞ה אֲחוֹתִ֤י הַחֲרִ֨ישִׁי֙ אָחִ֣יךְ ה֔וּא אַל־תָּשִׁ֥יתִי אֶת־לִבֵּ֖ךְ לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַתֵּ֤שֶׁב תָּמָר֙ וְשֹׁ֣מֵמָ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אַבְשָׁל֥וֹם אָחִֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to her Absalom her brother, [has] Aminon your brother been with you? And now, my sister, be silent; your brother [is] he; do not set your heart to this thing. And dwelt Tamar, and desolate, [in the] house of Absalom her brother.

en.L: And Absalom her brother said to her, "Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now, my sister, keep silent; he [is] your brother. Do not set your heart on this matter." And Tamar dwelt, a desolate [woman], in the house of Absalom her brother.
en.B: Absalom, her brother, asked her, "Has your brother Amnon been with you? Now, my sister, keep quiet. He is your brother. Do not take this matter to heart." So Tamar lived in her brother Absalom's house, a desolate woman.
en.R: Her brother Absalom asked her, "Has your brother Amnon done this to you? Now, my sister, say nothing about it. He is your brother. Do not let it break your heart." So Tamar lived on in her brother Absalom's house, alone and in despair.

es.L: Y Absalón su hermano le dijo: «¿Ha estado contigo Amnón tu hermano? Pues ahora, hermana mía, guarda silencio; él [es] tu hermano. No pongas tu corazón en este asunto». Y Tamar habitó, desolada, en la casa de Absalón su hermano.
es.B: Absalón, su hermano, le preguntó: «¿Ha estado contigo tu hermano Amnón? Ahora, hermana mía, quédate callada. Es tu hermano. No te tomes esto tan a pecho». Así que Tamar vivió en casa de su hermano Absalón, como una mujer desolada.
es.R: Su hermano Absalón le preguntó: «¿Te hizo esto tu hermano Amnón? Ahora, hermana mía, no digas nada. Él es tu hermano. No dejes que esto te destroce el corazón». Así que Tamar se quedó a vivir en casa de su hermano Absalón, sola y sin esperanza.

fr.L: Et Absalom son frère lui dit : « Amnon ton frère a-t-il été avec toi ? Mais maintenant, ma sœur, tais-toi ; c’[est] ton frère. Ne prends pas cette affaire à cœur. » Et Tamar demeura, désolée, dans la maison d’Absalom son frère.
fr.B: Son frère Absalom lui demanda : « Ton frère Amnon a-t-il été avec toi ? Maintenant, ma sœur, garde le silence. C’est ton frère. Ne prends pas cette affaire à cœur. » Et Tamar vécut, femme désolée, dans la maison de son frère Absalom.
fr.R: Son frère Absalom lui a demandé : « Est-ce que ton frère Amnon t’a fait cela ? Maintenant, ma sœur, n’en parle à personne. C’est ton frère. Ne te laisse pas briser par cette affaire. » Tamar est donc restée dans la maison de son frère Absalom, seule et sans espoir.

sw.L: Absalomu ndugu yake akamwambia, "Je, Amnoni ndugu yako amekuwa pamoja nawe? Lakini sasa, dada yangu, nyamaza; yeye [ni] ndugu yako. Usiliweke jambo hili moyoni mwako." Basi Tamari akakaa, [mwanamke] mkiwa, katika nyumba ya Absalomu ndugu yake.
sw.B: Absalomu, ndugu yake, akamwuliza, "Je, ndugu yako Amnoni amekuwa pamoja nawe? Sasa, dada yangu, nyamaza. Yeye ni ndugu yako. Usilitie jambo hili moyoni." Basi Tamari akakaa nyumbani kwa ndugu yake Absalomu, mwanamke mkiwa.
sw.R: Ndugu yake Absalomu akamwuliza, "Je, ndugu yako Amnoni amekutendea hivi? Sasa, dada yangu, usiseme lolote kuhusu jambo hili. Yeye ni ndugu yako. Usikubali likuvunje moyo." Basi Tamari akaendelea kuishi nyumbani kwa ndugu yake Absalomu, peke yake na bila tumaini.

vi.L: Áp-sa-lôm anh nàng nói với nàng: "Có phải Am-nôn anh em đã ở với em không? Nhưng bây giờ, em gái của anh, hãy im lặng; nó [là] anh của em. Đừng để lòng em vào chuyện này." Rồi Ta-ma ở, [một người đàn bà] cô quạnh, trong nhà Áp-sa-lôm anh mình.
vi.B: Áp-sa-lôm anh nàng hỏi: "Có phải Am-nôn anh em đã ăn nằm với em không? Bây giờ, em gái của anh, hãy im lặng. Nó là anh của em. Đừng để tâm đến chuyện này." Vậy Ta-ma sống trong nhà Áp-sa-lôm anh mình, như một người đàn bà cô quạnh.
vi.R: Áp-sa-lôm anh nàng hỏi: "Am-nôn anh em đã làm chuyện đó với em phải không? Bây giờ, em gái của anh, đừng nói gì với ai cả. Nó là anh của em. Đừng để chuyện này làm tan nát lòng em." Vậy Ta-ma ở lại trong nhà Áp-sa-lôm anh mình, cô đơn và tuyệt vọng.

ko.L: 그러자 그의 오라버니 압살롬이 그 여자에게 말했다. "네 오라버니 암논이 너와 함께 있었느냐? 그러나 이제 내 누이야, 잠잠하여라. 그는 네 오라버니다. 이 일을 네 마음에 두지 마라." 그리하여 다말은 처량한 [여인]으로 자기 오라버니 압살롬의 집에서 살았다.
ko.B: 다말의 오라버니 압살롬이 다말에게 물었다. "네 오라버니 암논이 너와 함께 있었느냐? 내 누이야, 지금은 잠자코 있거라. 그는 네 오라버니다. 이 일을 마음에 담아 두지 마라." 그리하여 다말은 오라버니 압살롬의 집에서 쓸쓸하게 지냈다.
ko.R: 다말의 오라버니 압살롬이 물었다. "네 오라버니 암논이 너에게 이런 짓을 했느냐? 내 누이야, 지금은 아무 말도 하지 마라. 그는 네 오라버니다. 이 일로 너무 상심하지 마라." 그 뒤로 다말은 오라버니 압살롬의 집에서 외롭게 절망 속에 살았다.

pt.L: E Absalão, seu irmão, lhe disse: "Amnom, seu irmão, esteve com você? Mas agora, minha irmã, fique calada; ele [é] seu irmão. Não ponha o seu coração nesta questão." E Tamar morou, desolada, na casa de Absalão, seu irmão.
pt.B: Absalão, irmão dela, lhe perguntou: "O seu irmão Amnom esteve com você? Agora, minha irmã, fique quieta. Ele é seu irmão. Não leve isso a peito." Assim Tamar ficou morando na casa do seu irmão Absalão, uma mulher desolada.
pt.R: O irmão dela, Absalão, perguntou: "Foi o seu irmão Amnom que fez isso com você? Agora, minha irmã, não diga nada a ninguém. Ele é seu irmão. Não deixe que isso parta o seu coração." Então Tamar continuou morando na casa do seu irmão Absalão, sozinha e sem esperança.

am.L: ወንድሟ አቤሴሎምም፦ «ወንድምሽ አምኖን ከአንቺ ጋር ነበረን? አሁንም፣ እኅቴ ሆይ፣ ዝም በዪ፤ እርሱ ወንድምሽ ነው፤ ይህን ነገር በልብሽ አታኑሪው» አላት። ትዕማርም በወንድሟ በአቤሴሎም ቤት ብቸኛ ሆና ተቀመጠች።
am.B: ወንድሟ አቤሴሎምም፦ «ወንድምሽ አምኖን ከአንቺ ጋር ነበረን? አሁንም እኅቴ ሆይ፣ ዝም በዪ፤ እርሱ ወንድምሽ ነው። ይህን ነገር በልብሽ አትያዢው» አላት። ስለዚህ ትዕማር ተስፋ የቆረጠች ሴት ሆና በወንድሟ በአቤሴሎም ቤት ተቀመጠች።
